}

		},
		revision: 0,
		eventCount: 0
	};
}
function on(e) {
	return {
		components: e.components.map((e) => ({
			...e,
			root: { ...e.root },
			tps: [{ ...e.tps[0] }, { ...e.tps[1] }]
		})),
		hull: { ...e.hull },
		debris: e.debris.map((e) => ({ ...e })),
		terminal: { ...e.terminal },
		revision: e.revision,
		eventCount: e.eventCount
	};
}

//#region src/core/physics/damage-root.ts
function sn(e) {
	let t = .1 * e, n = .15 * e, r = .05 * e, i = .004;
	if (!(t > 2 * i && n > 2 * i)) throw RangeError("Invalid attachment section");
	let a = t * n - (t - 2 * i) * (n - 2 * i), o = (t * n ** 3 - (t - 2 * i) * (n - 2 * i) ** 3) / 12;
	return Object.freeze({
		area: a,
		inertia: o,
		modulus: 2 * o / n,
		length: r,
		heatArea: t * r,
		mass: Ye * a * r
	});
}
function cn(e, t) {
	return t === "plate" ? Math.sin(e) : Math.hypot(Math.sin(2 * e), 1.2 * Math.sin(e) ** 2);
}
function ln(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	let o = Math.abs(e), s = a === "plate" ? Math.PI / 2 : Math.PI / 4;
	if (!Number.isFinite(e) || o > s || t < 0 || n < 0 || !Number.isFinite(t) || !Number.isFinite(n)) throw RangeError("Attachment load outside the monotone force domain");
	let c = jt(r);
	if (c === 0) return 0;
	if (o === 0 || t === 0 || n === 0) return e;
	let l = t * n * i.length / (c * i.inertia), u = o;
	for (let e = 0; e < 2; e++) {
		let e = cn(u, a), t = Math.sin(u), n = Math.cos(u), r = a === "plate" ? n : e === 0 ? 2 : (2 * Math.sin(2 * u) * Math.cos(2 * u) + 2.88 * t ** 3 * n) / e;
		if (u -= (u + l * e - o) / (1 + l * r), !(u > 0 && u <= o)) break;
	}
	if (u > 0 && u <= o) {
		let t = 0, n = o;
		for (let e = 0; e < 40; e++) {
			let e = (t + n) / 2;
			e < u ? t = e : n = e;
		}
		if (t + l * cn(t, a) < o && n + l * cn(n, a) >= o) return Math.sign(e) * (t + n) / 2;
	}
	let d = 0, f = o;
	for (let e = 0; e < 40; e++) {
		let e = (d + f) / 2;
		e + l * cn(e, a) < o ? d = e : f = e;
	}
	return Math.sign(e) * (d + f) / 2;
}
function un(e, t, n) {
	let r = Mt(t) * n.modulus;
	return r === 0 ? Infinity : Math.abs(e) / r;
}
//#endregion
//#region src/core/physics/vehicle-components.ts
var dn = 1525, fn = .004, pn = 144, mn = .0254, hn = 20 * Math.PI / 180;
function gn(e, t, n, r, i) {
	if (!(t > 0 && i > 0) || !Number.isFinite(t + n + r + i)) throw RangeError("Component slice requires positive finite mass and inertia");
	return Object.freeze({
		role: e,
		mass: t,
		x: n,
		station: r,
		inertia: i
	});
}
function _n(e, t, n, r, i = 0) {
	let a = n.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass, 0), o = n.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass * t.x, 0) / a, s = n.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass * t.station, 0) / a, c = n.reduce((e, t) => e + t.inertia + t.mass * ((t.x - o) ** 2 + (t.station - s) ** 2), 0);
	return Object.freeze({
		id: e,
		kind: t,
		mass: a,
		x: o,
		station: s,
		inertia: c,
		loadLever: i,
		rootMass: n.reduce((e, t) => e + (t.role === "root" ? t.mass : 0), 0),
		tpsMass: n.reduce((e, t) => e + (t.role === "tps" ? t.mass : 0), 0),
		...r ? { hinge: Object.freeze({ ...r }) } : {},
		slices: Object.freeze(n)
	});
}
function vn(e, t, n, r, i, a, o, s, c) {
	if (!(n > 0 && r > 0)) throw RangeError("Appendage area and span must be positive");
	let l = n / r, u = Ye * fn * n, d = i * (o + r / 2), f = i * (o + s.length / 2), p = s.heatArea / s.length, m = u * ((r * i) ** 2 + l ** 2) / 12, h = s.mass * ((s.length * i) ** 2 + p ** 2) / 12, g = [gn("structure", u, d, a, m), gn("root", s.mass, f, a, h)];
	if (c) {
		let e = pn * s.heatArea * mn;
		g.push(gn("tps", e, f, a, e * ((s.length * i) ** 2 + p ** 2) / 12));
	}
	return _n(e, t, g, {
		x: i * o,
		station: a
	}, r / 2);
}
function yn(e) {
	let { height: t, diameter: n, dryMass: r, dryCentreOfMass: i } = e;
	if (!(t > 0 && n > 0 && r > 0 && i > 0 && i < t) || !Number.isFinite(t + n + r + i)) throw RangeError("Invalid intact vehicle mass geometry");
	let a = n / 2, o = e.id === "ship", s = sn(n), c = [], l = t * (o ? .035 : .03), u = e.engines.length * dn;
	if (c.push(_n(`${o ? "ship" : "booster"}-engine-support`, "engine-support", [gn("structure", u, 0, l / 2, u * (a ** 2 / 4 + l ** 2 / 12))])), o) {
		let i = r * .05;
		c.push(_n("ship-nose", "nose", [gn("structure", i, 0, t * .87, i * ((.4 * a) ** 2 + (.08 * t) ** 2) / 5)]));
		for (let t of [!0, !1]) for (let r of [-1, 1]) {
			let i = t ? e.frontFinStation : e.aftFinStation;
			c.push(vn(`ship-${t ? "front" : "aft"}-flap-${r < 0 ? "left" : "right"}`, "flap", (t ? e.frontFinArea : e.aftFinArea) / 2, n * (t ? .34 : .46), r, i, a, s, !0));
		}
	} else {
		let i = e.gridFins;
		if (!i || !Number.isInteger(i.count) || i.count < 3) throw RangeError("Booster component partition requires a grid inventory");
		let o = r * .02;
		c.push(_n("booster-hot-stage", "hot-stage", [gn("structure", o, 0, t * .975, o * (a ** 2 / 2 + (.05 * t) ** 2 / 12))]));
		for (let e = 0; e < i.count; e++) c.push(vn(`booster-grid-${e}`, "grid-fin", i.area / i.count, n * .46, Math.sin(hn + e * 2 * Math.PI / i.count), i.station, a, s, !1));
	}
	for (let e of c) if (!(e.station >= 0 && e.station <= t)) throw RangeError("Component centroid outside the hull");
	let d = r - c.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass, 0);
	if (!(d > 0)) throw RangeError("No positive hull mass remains");
	let f = (r * i - c.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass * t.station, 0)) / d, p = -c.reduce((e, t) => e + t.mass * t.x, 0) / d, m = r * (a ** 2 / 4 + t ** 2 / 12), h = (m - c.reduce((e, t) => e + t.inertia + t.mass * (t.x ** 2 + (t.station - i) ** 2), 0) - d * (p ** 2 + (f - i) ** 2)) / d - a ** 2 / 4, g = t * (o ? .055 : .05), _ = t * (o ? .72 : .93), v = t * (o ? .3 : .5), y = (f - g) * (_ - f);
	if (!(f > g && f < _ && h > 0 && h < y)) throw RangeError("Hull residual moments have no positive supported partition");
	let b = h / y, x = d * b * (_ - f) / (_ - g), S = d * b * (f - g) / (_ - g), C = d - x - S, w = [
		gn("structure", x, p, g, x * a ** 2 / 4),
		gn("structure", C, p, f, C * a ** 2 / 4),
		gn("structure", S, p, _, S * a ** 2 / 4)
	], ee = o ? "ship" : "booster", T = _n(`${ee}-hull-aft`, "hull", w.filter((e) => e.station < v)), te = _n(`${ee}-hull-forward`, "hull", w.filter((e) => e.station >= v));
	return c.push(T, te), Object.freeze({
		id: e.id,
		dryMass: r,
		dryCentreOfMassX: 0,
		dryCentreOfMass: i,
		dryMomentOfInertia: m,
		hullThermalMass: T.mass + te.mass,
		rootSection: s,
		components: Object.freeze(c)
	});
}

//#region src/core/physics/damage-thermal.ts
var bn = 4096, xn = .8, Sn = 8, Cn = .0254, wn = Cn / 2, Tn = Cn / 4, En = Math.max(Nt, Ft), Dn = Math.min(Pt, It), On = xn * le, kn = Tt(4), An = Tt(Ze), jn = Xt(En), Mn = Xt(Dn);
function Nn(e) {
	let t = e.components.length, n = e.rootSection;
	if (t < 1 || t > 12 || !(e.hullThermalMass > 0 && n.area > 0 && n.length > 0 && n.heatArea > 0) || !Number.isFinite(e.hullThermalMass + n.area + n.length + n.heatArea)) throw RangeError("Invalid thermal catalogue geometry/inventory");
	let r = yt(4), i = bt(Ze), a = Yt(Nt), o = en(It, Lt), s = n.length / 2, c = n.area / s, l = s / n.area, u = i * c, d = 4 * On * n.heatArea * Ze ** 3, f = 4 * On * n.heatArea * Dn ** 3, p = [], m = Infinity, h = 0;
	for (let s = 0; s < t; s++) {
		let t = e.components[s];
		if (!(t.rootMass >= 0 && t.tpsMass >= 0) || !Number.isFinite(t.rootMass + t.tpsMass)) throw RangeError("Invalid component thermal masses");
		if (t.rootMass === 0) {
			if (t.tpsMass > 0) throw RangeError("TPS column requires a finite root");
			continue;
		}
		let g = t.tpsMass / 2, _ = t.rootMass * r;
		if (g > 0) {
			let e = o * n.heatArea / wn, t = 1 / (Tn / (o * n.heatArea) + l / i), r = g * a;
			m = Math.min(m, r / (e + f), r / (e + t), _ / (t + u));
		} else m = Math.min(m, _ / (u + d));
		h += u, p.push(Object.freeze({
			componentIndex: s,
			rootMass: t.rootMass,
			tpsCellMass: g,
			heatArea: n.heatArea,
			steelPathRatio: c,
			steelResistanceRatio: l,
			rootMinEnergy: t.rootMass * kn,
			rootMaxEnergy: t.rootMass * An,
			tpsMinEnergy: g * jn,
			tpsMaxEnergy: g * Mn
		}));
	}
	return h > 0 && (m = Math.min(m, e.hullThermalMass * r / h)), Object.freeze({
		componentCount: t,
		columns: Object.freeze(p),
		hullMass: e.hullThermalMass,
		hullMinEnergy: e.hullThermalMass * kn,
		hullMaxEnergy: e.hullThermalMass * An,
		safeStep: m
	});
}
function Pn(e, t, n) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(e.temperature) || e.temperature < t || e.temperature > n || !Number.isFinite(e.energy)) throw RangeError("Valid thermal node has invalid temperature/energy");
}
function Fn(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	return e.energy += t, !Number.isFinite(e.energy) || e.energy < r || e.energy > i ? (e.valid = !1, !1) : (t !== 0 && (e.temperature = e.energy === r ? a ? En : 4 : e.energy === i ? a ? Dn : Ze : a ? Zt(e.energy / n) : Ot(e.energy / n)), !0);
}
function In(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > t.safeStep * Sn || !Number.isFinite(r) || r < 0 || !Number.isFinite(i) || i < 186 || i > 1473.15 || !Number.isFinite(a) || a < 0 || a > 101330 || e.components.length !== t.componentCount) throw RangeError("Thermal forcing/inventory outside the supported numerical contract");
	let o = e.hull.valid ? 0 : bn;
	for (let n of t.columns) {
		let t = e.components[n.componentIndex];
		if (t.componentIndex !== n.componentIndex) throw RangeError("Thermal catalogue identity mismatch");
		t.attached && (!t.root.valid || n.tpsCellMass > 0 && (!t.tps[0].valid || !t.tps[1].valid)) && (o |= 1 << n.componentIndex);
	}
	if (o !== 0 || n === 0) return o;
	Pn(e.hull, 4, Ze);
	for (let n of t.columns) {
		let t = e.components[n.componentIndex];
		t.attached && (Pn(t.root, 4, Ze), n.tpsCellMass > 0 && (Pn(t.tps[0], En, Dn), Pn(t.tps[1], En, Dn)));
	}
	let s = Math.min(Sn, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(n / t.safeStep))), c = n / s, l = i ** 4;
	for (let n = 0; n < s; n++) {
		let n = e.hull.temperature, i = bt(n), s = 0;
		for (let u of t.columns) {
			let t = e.components[u.componentIndex];
			if (!t.attached) continue;
			let d = t.root.temperature, f = bt(d), p = c * (f + i) / 2 * u.steelPathRatio * (d - n);
			s += p;
			let m = -p, h = !0;
			if (u.tpsCellMass > 0) {
				let e = t.tps[0], n = t.tps[1], i = e.temperature, o = n.temperature, s = c * tn(i, o, a) * u.heatArea / wn * (i - o), p = c * (o - d) / (Tn / (en(o, a) * u.heatArea) + u.steelResistanceRatio / f), g = c * u.heatArea * (r - On * (i ** 4 - l));
				m += p, h = Fn(e, g - s, u.tpsCellMass, u.tpsMinEnergy, u.tpsMaxEnergy, !0), Fn(n, s - p, u.tpsCellMass, u.tpsMinEnergy, u.tpsMaxEnergy, !0) || (h = !1);
			} else m += c * u.heatArea * (r - On * (d ** 4 - l));
			Fn(t.root, m, u.rootMass, u.rootMinEnergy, u.rootMaxEnergy, !1) || (h = !1), h || (o |= 1 << u.componentIndex);
		}
		if (Fn(e.hull, s, t.hullMass, t.hullMinEnergy, t.hullMaxEnergy, !1) || (o |= bn), o !== 0) return o;
	}
	return 0;
}

//#region src/core/physics/damage-controls.ts
function Ln(e, t) {
	let n = [];
	for (let r = 0; r < e.components.length; r++) {
		let i = e.components[r];
		if (i.kind === "grid-fin") {
			let e = t.gridFins;
			if (!e) throw RangeError("Grid component requires grid geometry");
			n.push(Object.freeze({
				index: r,
				group: "grid",
				area: e.area / e.count,
				lever: i.loadLever
			}));
		} else if (i.kind === "flap") {
			let e = i.id.includes("-front-");
			n.push(Object.freeze({
				index: r,
				group: e ? "front" : "aft",
				area: (e ? t.frontFinArea : t.aftFinArea) / 2,
				lever: i.loadLever
			}));
		}
	}
	return Object.freeze({
		componentCount: e.components.length,
		root: e.rootSection,
		columns: Object.freeze(n)
	});
}
function Rn(e) {
	return {
		frontArea: 0,
		aftArea: 0,
		frontFraction: 0,
		aftFraction: 0,
		gridLiftArea: 0,
		gridDragArea: 0,
		loadedAngles: Array(e).fill(0),
		proofMask: 0,
		domainMask: 0
	};
}
function zn(e, t, n, r, i) {
	if (!(n >= 0 && r >= 0 && r <= 1) || !Number.isFinite(n) || e.components.length !== t.componentCount || i.loadedAngles.length < t.componentCount) throw RangeError("Invalid component control forcing or inventory");
}
function Bn(e, t, n, r, i, a, o) {
	zn(e, t, n, r, o), o.frontArea = o.aftArea = o.gridLiftArea = o.gridDragArea = 0, o.frontFraction = o.aftFraction = 0, o.proofMask = o.domainMask = 0, o.loadedAngles.fill(0);
	for (let s of t.columns) {
		let c = e.components[s.index];
		if (!c.attached || c.permanentFailure !== nn.None) continue;
		if (!c.root.valid || Mt(c.root.temperature) === 0) {
			o.domainMask |= 1 << s.index;
			continue;
		}
		let l = s.group === "grid", u = s.group === "aft" ? a : i, d = n * s.area * (l ? 1 : 2 * r), f = l ? "grid" : "plate", p = ln(u, d, s.lever, c.root.temperature, t.root, f);
		if (o.loadedAngles[s.index] = p, un(d * cn(Math.abs(p), f) * s.lever, c.root.temperature, t.root) > 1) {
			o.proofMask |= 1 << s.index;
			continue;
		}
		if (l) o.gridLiftArea += s.area * Math.sin(2 * p), o.gridDragArea += s.area * 1.2 * Math.sin(p) ** 2;
		else {
			let e = Math.sin(p);
			s.group === "front" ? (o.frontArea += s.area * e, o.frontFraction += .5 * e) : (o.aftArea += s.area * e, o.aftFraction += .5 * e);
		}
	}
}

//#region src/core/physics/isa.ts
var Vn = w, Hn = 287.053, Un = 288.15, Wn = T;
function Gn() {
	let e = [
		[0, -.0065],
		[11e3, 0],
		[2e4, .001],
		[32e3, .0028],
		[47e3, 0],
		[51e3, -.0028],
		[71e3, -.002]
	], t = [], n = Un, r = Wn;
	for (let i = 0; i < e.length; i++) {
		let [a, o] = e[i];
		t.push({
			baseAltitude: a,
			baseTemperature: n,
			basePressure: r,
			lapseRate: o
		});
		let s = e[i + 1];
		if (!s) break;
		let c = s[0] - a, l = n + o * c;
		r = Kn(r, n, o, c), n = l;
	}
	return t;
}
function Kn(e, t, n, r) {
	return n === 0 ? e * Math.exp(-Vn * r / (Hn * t)) : e * ((t + n * r) / t) ** (-Vn / (Hn * n));
}
var qn = Gn(), Jn = 84852, Yn = 6356766;
function Xn(e) {
	return Yn * e / (Yn + e);
}
function Zn(e) {
	let t = qn[0];
	for (let n of qn) if (e >= n.baseAltitude) t = n;
	else break;
	return t;
}
var Qn = 86e3, $n = [
	[86e3, 5440],
	[1e5, 5877],
	[11e4, 7263],
	[12e4, 9473],
	[13e4, 12636],
	[14e4, 16149],
	[15e4, 22523],
	[18e4, 29740],
	[2e5, 37105],
	[25e4, 45546],
	[3e5, 53628],
	[35e4, 53298],
	[4e5, 58515],
	[45e4, 60828],
	[5e5, 63822],
	[6e5, 71835],
	[7e5, 88667],
	[8e5, 124640],
	[9e5, 181050],
	[1e6, 268e3]
], er = 1e3, tr = (() => {
	let e = [], t = nr(Qn);
	for (let n = 0; n < $n.length; n++) {
		let [r, i] = $n[n];
		e.push({
			base: r,
			density: t,
			scaleHeight: i
		});
		let a = $n[n + 1];
		a && (t *= Math.exp(-(a[0] - r) / i));
	}
	return e;
})();
function nr(e) {
	let { pressurePascal: t, temperatureKelvin: n } = rr(e);
	return t / (Hn * n);
}
function rr(e) {
	let t = {
		pressurePascal: 0,
		temperatureKelvin: 0
	};
	return ir(e, t), t;
}
function ir(e, t) {
	let n = Math.max(Xn(e), 0), r = Math.min(n, Jn), i = Zn(r), a = r - i.baseAltitude;
	t.temperatureKelvin = i.baseTemperature + i.lapseRate * a, t.pressurePascal = Kn(i.basePressure, i.baseTemperature, i.lapseRate, a);
}
function ar(e) {
	let t = {
		airTemperature: 0,
		airPressure: 0,
		airDensity: 0
	};
	return hr(e, t), t;
}
var or = 186.8673, sr = 263.1905, cr = -76.3232, lr = -19.9429, ur = 240, dr = 12, fr = Yn / 1e3;
function pr(e) {
	let t = e / 1e3;
	if (t <= 91) return or;
	if (t <= 110) return sr + cr * Math.sqrt(1 - ((t - 91) / lr) ** 2);
	if (t <= 120) return ur + dr * (t - 110);
	let n = (t - 120) * 6476.766 / (fr + t);
	return er - 640 * Math.exp(-.01875 * n);
}
var mr = {
	pressurePascal: 0,
	temperatureKelvin: 0
};
function hr(e, t) {
	if (e <= 86e3) {
		ir(e, mr);
		let { pressurePascal: n, temperatureKelvin: r } = mr;
		t.airTemperature = r - 273.15, t.airPressure = n / 1e3, t.airDensity = n / (Hn * r);
		return;
	}
	let n = tr[0];
	for (let t of tr) if (e >= t.base) n = t;
	else break;
	let r = n.density * Math.exp(-(e - n.base) / n.scaleHeight), i = pr(e);
	t.airTemperature = i - 273.15, t.airPressure = r * Hn * i / 1e3, t.airDensity = r;
}

//#region src/core/physics/atmosphere.ts
function gr(e) {
	return ar(e);
}
var _r = 1.4, vr = 287.053;
function yr(e) {
	return Math.sqrt(_r * vr * (e + 273.15));
}

var br = /* @__PURE__ */ t({

function xr(e, t) {
	return e * t ** 2 * 5e-4;
}
function Sr(e, t, n = E) {
	return Math.abs(Math.sin(e) * t) + Math.abs(Math.cos(e) * n.minArea) / 2.1;
}
function k(e, t, n, r) {
	return 1 / 2 * e * t ** 2 * r * n;
}
function Cr(e) {
	let t = Math.abs(e);
	return t >= 1.48 ? -1.1 * t + 1.728 : t >= .52 ? -1 / 9.6 * t + .254 : t >= .47 ? -8 * t + 4.36 : t >= .35 ? 5 / 6 * t + .2083 : 5 / 3.5 * t;
}
function wr(e, t, n, r) {
	return Cr(n) * e * t ** 2 * r * .5;
}
function Tr(e) {
	return e >= 10 ? 2.5 : e * .1347 + 1.153;
}
function Er(e, t) {
	return e / t;
}
function Dr(e, t, n) {
	return e * t / n;
}
function Or(e, t) {
	return n(Math.atan2(e, t));
}
function kr(e, t, n, r) {
	return Math.sqrt((e - n) ** 2 + (t - r) ** 2);
}
function Ar(e, t, n, r) {
	return Or(e - n, t - r);
}
function jr(e, t) {
	let r = Mr(e, t);
	return {
		angleOfAttack: n(r),
		angleInToTheWind: n(Nr(r))
	};
}
function Mr(e, t) {
	let n = e - t;
	return n < -Math.PI ? n = Math.PI * 2 + n : n > Math.PI && (n = -(Math.PI * 2 - n)), n;
}
function Nr(e) {
	return e > Math.PI / 2 ? Math.PI - e : e < -Math.PI / 2 ? -Math.PI - e : e;
}
function Pr(e, t, n, r, i = E) {
	let a = e * i.diameter * t ** 2 * r / n;
	return t > 0 ? -a : a;
}
function Fr(e, t, n, r, i, a = E) {
	let o = k(e, t, Math.abs(Math.sin(r)) * a.frontFinArea, 2) * i;
	return n < 0 ? -o : o;
}
function Ir(e, t, n, r, i, a = E) {
	let o = k(e, t, Math.abs(Math.sin(r)) * a.aftFinArea, 2) * i;
	return n < 0 ? o : -o;
}
function Lr(e, t, n = E) {
	let r = Math.sin(re * e * .01), i = Math.sin(re * t * .01), a = r * n.frontFinArea + i * n.aftFinArea;
	return {
		frontFinEffectiveAreaFraction: r,
		aftFinEffectiveAreaFraction: i,
		totalFinSurfaceArea: a,
		vehicleInFlightMaxArea: n.maxArea + a * 1.8
	};
}
function Rr(e, t) {
	return e === Rr && t === Sr;
}

//#region src/core/physics/gravity.ts
var zr = s;
function Br(e) {
	return zr / e ** 2;
}
function Vr(e) {
	return Math.sqrt(zr / e);
}
function Hr(e, t, n = 0) {
	return Wr(e, t, n) ** 2 / e - Br(e);
}
function Ur(e, t = 0) {
	return -Hr(e, 0, t);
}
function Wr(e, t, n = 0) {
	return n === 0 ? t : t + n * e;
}
function Gr(e, t, n = 0) {
	return n === 0 ? t : t - n * e;
}
function Kr(e, t, n, r = 0) {
	let i = r === 0 ? t : t + 2 * r * e;
	return -n * i / e;
}
function qr(e, t, n, r, i = 0) {
	let a = Wr(e, t, i), o = (a ** 2 + n ** 2) / 2 - zr / e, s = e * a, c = 1 + 2 * o * s ** 2 / zr ** 2, l = Math.sqrt(Math.max(c, 0)), u = s ** 2 / zr;
	if (l < 1e-9 || u / (1 + l) > r) return Infinity;
	let d = (e, t) => {
		let n = (u / e - 1) / l, r = Math.acos(Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, n)));
		return t ? r : 2 * Math.PI - r;
	}, f = d(e, n >= 0), p = d(r, !1);
	if (p < f && (p += 2 * Math.PI), !(p > f)) {
		if (i === 0) return 0;
		if (n > 0 && o >= 0) return Infinity;
		let t = Xr(e, n, r);
		return Number.isFinite(t) ? -i * t : Infinity;
	}
	let m = (p - f) / 64, h = (e) => u / (1 + l * Math.cos(e)), g = h(f) + h(p);
	for (let e = 1; e < 64; e++) g += h(f + e * m) * (e % 2 == 0 ? 2 : 4);
	let _ = g * m / 3;
	if (i === 0) return _;
	let v = h(f) ** 3 + h(p) ** 3;
	for (let e = 1; e < 64; e++) v += h(f + e * m) ** 3 * (e % 2 == 0 ? 2 : 4);
	return _ - v * m * i / 3 / s;
}
var Jr = .1, Yr = 1e6;
function Xr(e, t, n) {
	let r = e, i = t, a = -Br(r), o = 0;
	for (let e = 0; e < Yr; e++) {
		let e = r + i * Jr + .5 * a * Jr * Jr;
		if (e <= n) {
			let t = (r - n) / (r - e);
			return o + .5 * (r + n) * t * Jr;
		}
		let t = -Br(e);
		i += .5 * (a + t) * Jr, o += .5 * (r + e) * Jr, r = e, a = t;
	}
	return Infinity;
}

//#region src/core/physics/damage-debris.ts
function Zr(e, t) {
	if (e.id !== t.id || e.dryMass !== t.dryMass) throw RangeError("Debris requires matching source vehicle inventory");
	let n = t.diameter, r = t.height, i = t.id === "ship", a = e.components.map((a) => {
		let o, s, c, l = a.kind === "flap" || a.kind === "grid-fin";
		if (l) {
			let r = a.id.startsWith("ship-front"), i = n * (a.kind === "grid-fin" || !r ? .46 : .34);
			o = a.kind === "grid-fin" ? t.gridFins.area / t.gridFins.count : (r ? t.frontFinArea : t.aftFinArea) / 2;
			let l = o / i;
			s = o + .004 * (i + l) + e.rootSection.heatArea, c = 0;
			for (let t of a.slices) {
				let n = t.role === "structure" ? Math.hypot(i, l) / 2 : Math.hypot(e.rootSection.length, e.rootSection.heatArea / e.rootSection.length) / 2;
				c = Math.max(c, Math.hypot(t.x - a.x, t.station - a.station) + n);
			}
		} else {
			let e, t = n;
			a.kind === "engine-support" ? e = r * (i ? .035 : .03) : a.kind === "nose" ? (e = .08 * r, t = .4 * n) : e = a.kind === "hot-stage" ? .05 * r : r * (a.id.endsWith("-aft") ? i ? .3 : .5 : i ? .7 : .5), o = t * e, s = o + Math.PI * t * t / 4;
			let l = 0;
			for (let e of a.slices) l = Math.max(l, Math.hypot(e.x - a.x, e.station - a.station));
			c = l + Math.hypot(t, e) / 2;
		}
		if (!(a.mass > 0 && a.inertia > 0 && s > 0 && c > 0) || !Number.isFinite(a.mass + a.inertia + s + c)) throw RangeError("Debris source geometry must be positive and finite");
		return Object.freeze({
			mass: a.mass,
			inertia: a.inertia,
			broadsideArea: o,
			dragArea: s,
			supportRadius: c,
			dragMultiplier: l ? 1.8 : 1
		});
	});
	return Object.freeze({ pieces: Object.freeze(a) });
}
var Qr = {
	airDensity: 0,
	airTemperature: 0,
	airPressure: 0
};
function $r(e, t, n) {
	if (!(t >= 0 && n >= 0) || !Number.isFinite(t + n)) throw RangeError("Debris drag requires finite nonnegative coefficient and time");
	let r = Math.hypot(e.speedX, e.speedY), i = 1 / (1 + t * r * n);
	return e.speedX *= i, e.speedY *= i, -.5 * r * r * (1 - i) * (1 + i);
}
function ei(e, t, n) {
	hr(e.altitude, Qr);
	let r = Tr(Math.hypot(e.speedX, e.speedY) / yr(Qr.airTemperature));
	$r(e, Qr.airDensity * r * t.dragMultiplier * t.dragArea / (2 * t.mass), n);
}
function ti(e, t, r) {
	if (!(r >= 0) || !Number.isFinite(r) || e.debris.length !== t.pieces.length) throw RangeError("Debris advance requires matching inventory and finite nonnegative time");
	for (let t = 0; t < e.debris.length; t++) {
		let n = e.debris[t];
		if (n.componentIndex !== t || n.active && !Number.isFinite(n.x + n.altitude + n.speedX + n.speedY + n.pitch + n.angularVelocity)) throw RangeError("Debris active pose and source index must be finite and valid");
	}
	if (r !== 0) for (let i = 0; i < e.debris.length; i++) {
		let o = e.debris[i];
		if (!o.active) continue;
		let s = t.pieces[i];
		if (o.altitude <= s.supportRadius) {
			o.altitude = s.supportRadius, o.speedX = o.speedY = o.angularVelocity = 0;
			continue;
		}
		ei(o, s, r / 2);
		let c = o.x, l = o.altitude, u = o.speedX, d = o.speedY, f = a + l, p = Kr(f, u, d), m = Hr(f, u), h = c + u * r + .5 * p * r * r, g = l + d * r + .5 * m * r * r;
		if (g <= s.supportRadius) {
			let e = (l - s.supportRadius) / (l - g);
			o.x = c + (h - c) * e, o.altitude = s.supportRadius, o.pitch = n(o.pitch + o.angularVelocity * r * e), o.speedX = o.speedY = o.angularVelocity = 0;
			continue;
		}
		let _ = a + g;
		o.x = h, o.altitude = g, o.speedX = u + .5 * (p + Kr(_, u + p * r, d + m * r)) * r, o.speedY = d + .5 * (m + Hr(_, u + p * r)) * r, o.pitch = n(o.pitch + o.angularVelocity * r), ei(o, s, r / 2);
	}
}

function ji() {
	return {
		hasMass: !1,
		retainedDryMass: 0,
		propellantMass: 0,
		totalMass: 0,
		dryCentreOfMassX: 0,
		dryCentreOfMass: 0,
		dryMomentOfInertia: 0,

		aftFinCount: 0,

		frontFinArea: 0,
		aftFinArea: 0,
		gridFinArea: 0,
		engineSupportAvailable: !1
	};
}
function Mi(e, t, n, r, i) {
	if (!Number.isFinite(n) || t.id !== r.id || t.dryMass !== r.dryMass || t.dryCentreOfMass !== r.dryCentreOfMass || t.dryMomentOfInertia !== r.dryMass * ((r.diameter / 2) ** 2 / 4 + r.height ** 2 / 12) || e.components.length !== t.components.length) throw RangeError("Retained mass requires matching component/model inventory and finite propellant");
	i.hasMass = !1, i.retainedDryMass = 0, i.propellantMass = Math.max(0, n), i.totalMass = 0, i.dryCentreOfMassX = i.dryCentreOfMass = i.dryMomentOfInertia = 0, i.centreOfMassX = i.centreOfMass = i.momentOfInertia = 0, i.frontFinCount = i.aftFinCount = i.gridFinCount = 0, i.frontFinArea = i.aftFinArea = i.gridFinArea = 0, i.engineSupportAvailable = !1;
	let a = !0, o = 0, s = 0;
	for (let n = 0; n < t.components.length; n++) {
		let r = e.components[n];
		if (r.componentIndex !== n) throw RangeError("Component indices must retain catalogue order");
		if (!r.attached) {
			a = !1;
			continue;
		}
		let c = t.components[n];
		i.retainedDryMass += c.mass, o += c.mass * c.x, s += c.mass * c.station, c.kind === "flap" ? c.id.startsWith("ship-front-flap-") ? i.frontFinCount++ : c.id.startsWith("ship-aft-flap-") && i.aftFinCount++ : c.kind === "grid-fin" ? i.gridFinCount++ : c.kind === "engine-support" && (i.engineSupportAvailable = r.permanentFailure === nn.None);
	}
	if (i.frontFinArea = r.frontFinArea * i.frontFinCount / 2, i.aftFinArea = r.aftFinArea * i.aftFinCount / 2, i.gridFinArea = r.gridFins ? r.gridFins.area * i.gridFinCount / r.gridFins.count : 0, a) {
		i.retainedDryMass = r.dryMass, i.dryCentreOfMassX = t.dryCentreOfMassX, i.dryCentreOfMass = r.dryCentreOfMass, i.dryMomentOfInertia = t.dryMomentOfInertia, i.totalMass = r.dryMass + i.propellantMass, i.hasMass = !0, i.centreOfMassX = 0, i.centreOfMass = Ue(i.propellantMass, r), i.momentOfInertia = Ge(i.propellantMass, r);
		return;
	}
	if (i.retainedDryMass > 0) {
		i.dryCentreOfMassX = o / i.retainedDryMass, i.dryCentreOfMass = s / i.retainedDryMass;
		for (let n = 0; n < t.components.length; n++) if (e.components[n].attached) {
			let e = t.components[n];
			i.dryMomentOfInertia += e.inertia + e.mass * ((e.x - i.dryCentreOfMassX) ** 2 + (e.station - i.dryCentreOfMass) ** 2);
		}
	}
	if (i.totalMass = i.retainedDryMass + i.propellantMass, i.totalMass === 0) return;
	i.hasMass = !0;
	let c = Math.min(1, i.propellantMass / r.propellantCapacity), l = i.propellantMass * Ne, u = i.propellantMass * (1 - Ne), d = r.loxTankHeight * c, f = r.ch4TankHeight * c, p = r.tankBottom + d / 2, m = r.ch4TankBottom + f / 2;
	i.centreOfMassX = o / i.totalMass, i.centreOfMass = (s + l * p + u * m) / i.totalMass;
	for (let n = 0; n < t.components.length; n++) if (e.components[n].attached) {
		let e = t.components[n];
		i.momentOfInertia += e.inertia + e.mass * ((e.x - i.centreOfMassX) ** 2 + (e.station - i.centreOfMass) ** 2);
	}
	let h = (r.diameter / 2) ** 2 / 4;
	i.momentOfInertia += l * (h + d ** 2 / 12 + i.centreOfMassX ** 2 + (p - i.centreOfMass) ** 2), i.momentOfInertia += u * (h + f ** 2 / 12 + i.centreOfMassX ** 2 + (m - i.centreOfMass) ** 2);
}

//#region src/core/physics/damage-detachment.ts
function Fi() {

		before: ji(),
		after: ji()

function Ii(e, t, n, r, i, a, o, s) {
	let c = t.components.length;
	if (c < 1 || c > 12 || e.components.length !== c || e.debris.length !== c || !Number.isInteger(a) || a < 0 || a > (1 << c) - 1) throw RangeError("Detachment requires a bounded matching component mask");
	if (s.before === s.after) throw RangeError("Detachment mass snapshots require distinct scratch");
	if (!Number.isFinite(i.x) || !Number.isFinite(i.altitude) || !Number.isFinite(i.pitch) || !Number.isFinite(i.vx) || !Number.isFinite(i.vy) || !Number.isFinite(i.omega)) throw RangeError("Detachment requires a finite physical COM pose");

		coastPitch: n.boosterCoastPitch,
		reached: n.boosterForecastReached,
		plan: n.boosterReturnPlan
	});
}
function Ha(e, t) {
	let n = e.autopilot;
	t.rangeError === void 0 ? delete n.boosterRangeError : n.boosterRangeError = t.rangeError, t.fallTime === void 0 ? delete n.boosterFallTime : n.boosterFallTime = t.fallTime, t.coastPitch === void 0 ? delete n.boosterCoastPitch : n.boosterCoastPitch = t.coastPitch, t.reached === void 0 ? delete n.boosterForecastReached : n.boosterForecastReached = t.reached;
	let r = za(t.plan);
	r ? n.boosterReturnPlan = r : delete n.boosterReturnPlan;
}
function Ua(e) {
	let t = e.autopilot;
	t.boosterSource && (t.boosterSource.valid = !1), delete t.boosterReturnPlan, delete t.boosterCoastPitch, delete t.boosterForecastReached, t.boosterPrediction?.published && (t.boosterPrediction = {
		...t.boosterPrediction,
		published: void 0
	});
}
function Wa(e, t, n = !1) {
	if (Object.is(e, t)) return !0;
	if (e === null || t === null || typeof e != "object" || typeof t != "object" || Array.isArray(e) !== Array.isArray(t) || Array.isArray(e) && e.length !== t.length) return !1;
	let r = e, i = t;
	for (let e in r) if (!(n && (e === "boosterSource" || e === "boosterPrediction")) && (!(e in i) || !Wa(r[e], i[e], e === "autopilot"))) return !1;
	for (let e in i) if (!(n && (e === "boosterSource" || e === "boosterPrediction")) && !(e in r)) return !1;
	return !0;
}
function Ga(e, t) {
	if (!e.damage) return !0;
	let n = e.autopilot, r = n.boosterSource;
	return r ? r.revision !== e.damage.revision || !r.valid || !r.expected || r.expectedDt !== t || !Wa(r.expected, e) || n.boosterReturnPlan && n.boosterReturnPlan.sourceLineage !== r.lineageId ? (Ua(e), !1) : (r.checked = !0, !0) : !n.boosterReturnPlan || (Ua(e), !1);
}
function Ka(e) {
	if (!e.damage) return;
	let t = e.autopilot, n = t.boosterSource;
	if (n && n.revision === e.damage.revision && (n.valid || t.boosterPrediction && !t.boosterPrediction.done)) return;
	n && delete t.boosterPrediction, delete t.boosterReturnPlan;
	let r = V(e);
	t.boosterSource = {
		lineageId: (n?.lineageId ?? 0) + 1,
		revision: e.damage.revision,
		originTime: e.world.environmentTime,
		valid: !0,
		checked: !0,
		returned: r,
		expected: void 0,
		expectedDt: 0,
		event: Va(e, 0)
	};
}
function qa(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	let o = e.autopilot.boosterSource;
	if (!o || !o.valid) return 0;
	if (!o.checked || o.returned.world.environmentTime !== e.world.environmentTime) return Ua(e), 0;
	let s = Va(e, o.event.sequence + 1), c = V(o.returned);
	if (Ha(c, s), a) return Wa(s, a.event) ? (e.autopilot.boosterSource = {
		...o,
		event: s,
		returned: V(a.returned),
		expected: V(a.expected),
		expectedDt: t,
		checked: !1
	}, 0) : (Ua(e), 0);
	let l, u = n(c, t, (e, t, n) => {
		l = V(e), r(e, t, n);
	}, i);
	return e.autopilot.boosterSource = {
		...o,
		event: s,
		returned: V(u),
		expected: l,
		expectedDt: t,
		checked: !1,
		valid: l !== void 0
	}, l || Ua(e), 1;
}
function Ja(e, t, n, r, i) {
	let a = e.autopilot.boosterSource;
	if (!a?.valid || !a.checked || !a.receipts || a.returned.world.environmentTime !== e.world.environmentTime) return;
	let o = Va(e, a.event.sequence + 1), s = V(a.returned);
	if (Ha(s, o), !ja(s, t)) return;
	let c = Ra(a.receipts, s, t, n, r, i, a.lineageId, a.revision);
	if (e.autopilot.boosterSource = {
		...a,
		receipts: c.queue
	}, !c.receipt) return;
	let l = V(c.receipt.expected), u = V(c.receipt.returned);
	return Ma(l, s), Ma(u, s), {
		event: o,
		expected: l,
		returned: u
	};
}
function Ya(e, t, n, r, i, a, o, s) {
	let c = e.autopilot.boosterSource;
	if (!n || !Za(e, t, i)) return;
	let l = Fa(t, n, r, i, a, o, s, c.lineageId, c.revision);
	e.autopilot.boosterSource = {
		...c,
		receipts: La(c.receipts, l)
	};
}
function Xa(e, t) {
	let n = e.autopilot.boosterSource;
	return !!n && Wa(Va(e, n.event.sequence + 1), t.event);
}
function Za(e, t, n) {
	let r = e.autopilot.boosterSource;
	return !!r?.valid && ja(t, n) && Ia(r.receipts, t.world.environmentTime);
}

function eo(e) {
	return {
		damage: e.damage ? on(e.damage) : null,
		rng: {
			seed: e.rng.seed,
			counters: { ...e.rng.counters }
		},
		world: { ...e.world },
		atmosphere: { ...e.atmosphere },
		kinematics: {
			...e.kinematics,
			pitchRecord: [e.kinematics.pitchRecord[0], e.kinematics.pitchRecord[1]]
		},
		forces: { ...e.forces },
		vehicle: { ...e.vehicle },
		engines: {
			running: [...e.engines.running],
			failed: [...e.engines.failed],
			ignitionCountdown: [...e.engines.ignitionCountdown]
		},
		status: { ...e.status },
		warnings: { ...e.warnings },
		failures: { ...e.failures },
		autopilot: {
			...e.autopilot,
			...e.autopilot.boosterReturnPlan ? { boosterReturnPlan: za(e.autopilot.boosterReturnPlan) } : {},
			...e.autopilot.boosterSource ? { boosterSource: {
				...e.autopilot.boosterSource,
				returned: eo(e.autopilot.boosterSource.returned),
				expected: e.autopilot.boosterSource.expected ? eo(e.autopilot.boosterSource.expected) : void 0,
				event: Ba(e.autopilot.boosterSource.event)
			} } : {}
		}
	};
}

//#region src/core/physics/wind.ts
var to = 18.3, no = .52, ro = 2, io = 1, ao = .3048, oo = 20 * ao, so = 10 * ao, co = 1e3 * ao;
function lo(e) {
	return no * Math.max(Math.abs(e), ro) ** -.75;
}
function uo(e, t) {
	return e === 0 ? 0 : e * (Math.min(Math.max(t, io), 150) / to) ** lo(e);
}
function H(e, t) {
	return uo(e.wind, t) + e.gust;
}
function fo(e, t, n) {
	let r = Math.min(Math.max(t, so), co) / ao, i = .177 + 823e-6 * r, a = .1 * Math.abs(e);
	return n.sigmaW = a, n.sigmaU = a / i ** .4, n.lengthW = r * ao, n.lengthU = r / i ** 1.2 * ao, n;
}
var po = {
	sigmaU: 0,
	sigmaW: 0,
	lengthU: 0,
	lengthW: 0
}, mo = Math.sqrt(3), ho = 2;
function go(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	if (e.wind === 0) return;
	fo(uo(e.wind, oo), n, po);
	let o = Math.hypot(r - uo(e.wind, n), i), s = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1 - Ai(t, "turbulence"))), c = 2 * Math.PI * Ai(t, "turbulence"), l = s * Math.cos(c), u = s * Math.sin(c), d = Math.exp(-o * a / po.lengthU);
	e.turbulenceU = d * e.turbulenceU + Math.sqrt(1 - d * d) * l;
	let f = Math.exp(-o * a / po.lengthW), p = e.turbulenceW1;
	e.turbulenceW1 = f * p + Math.sqrt(1 - f * f) * u, e.turbulenceW2 = f * e.turbulenceW2 + (1 - f) * p, e.gust = po.sigmaU * e.turbulenceU, e.gustVertical = po.sigmaW / Math.sqrt(ho) * (mo * e.turbulenceW1 + (1 - mo) * e.turbulenceW2);
}
//#endregion

function To(e, t) {
	return Do(e, t, E);
}
function Eo(e, t) {
	let n = e.id === "custom" ? e.basedOn : e.id, r = n === "booster-sep" || n === "rtls" ? bi : E;
	return {
		state: Do(e, t, r),
		vehicle: r
	};
}
function Do(e, t, n) {
	let r = $a(t, n), o = e.altitude;
	o < n.height / 2 && (o = n.height / 2), r.kinematics.altitude = o, r.kinematics.distanceToPlanetCenter = a + o, r.kinematics.downRangeDistance = e.xPosition + d, r.kinematics.downRangeDistanceNextFrame = r.kinematics.downRangeDistance, r.kinematics.speedX = e.speedX, r.kinematics.speedY = e.speedY, r.kinematics.trueSpeed = Math.sqrt(e.speedX ** 2 + e.speedY ** 2), r.kinematics.pitch = i(e.pitch), n.gridFins && (r.kinematics.pitchRecord = [r.kinematics.pitch, r.kinematics.pitch]);
	let s = e.propellant * 1e3;
	return s > n.propellantCapacity && (s = n.propellantCapacity), s > 0 || (s = 0), r.vehicle.propellantMass = s, r.vehicle.vehicleMass = n.dryMass + s, n.gridFins && (r.vehicle.vehicleMomentOfInertia = Ge(s, n)), r.world.wind = e.wind ?? 0, r.kinematics.machSpeed = kr(r.kinematics.speedX, r.kinematics.speedY, H(r.world, r.kinematics.altitude), r.world.gustVertical) / yr(ar(o).airTemperature), r.damage = an(A(n).partition, si(o, ar(o).airTemperature)), r;
}

	return t.status.finLocked = !0, t.autopilot.demoAutoLandOn = !0, B(t), t;
}

//#region src/core/physics/components.ts
var ko = Math.PI / 2;
function Ao(e) {
	return -Math.sin(e);
}
function jo(e) {
	return -Math.cos(e);
}
function Mo(e) {
	return -Math.cos(e);
}
function No(e) {
	return Math.sin(e);
}
function Po(e) {
	return Math.sin(e);
}
function Fo(e) {
	return Math.cos(e);
}
function Io(e) {
	return 0 < e && e < ko || -Math.PI < e && e < -ko;
}
function Lo(e, t) {
	let n = t(e.gimbalPointingDirection) * e.thrustAcceleration, r = e.fixedThrustAcceleration;
	return r === 0 ? n : n + t(e.pitch) * r;
}
function Ro(e) {
	let t = Ao(e.angleOfMotion) * e.aerodynamicDragAcceleration, n = Mo(e.angleOfMotion), r = Io(e.angleOfAttack) ? -n * e.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration : n * e.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration;
	return t + Lo(e, Po) + r;
}
function zo(e, t) {
	let n = jo(e.angleOfMotion) * e.aerodynamicDragAcceleration, r = No(e.angleOfMotion), i = Io(e.angleOfAttack) ? -r * e.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration : r * e.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration, a = Lo(e, Fo);
	return -t + n + a + i;
}
function Bo(e, t, n) {
	let r = Math.sin(e.angleOfMotion), i = Math.cos(e.angleOfMotion), a = Io(e.angleOfAttack), o = -r * e.aerodynamicDragAcceleration, s = -i * e.aerodynamicDragAcceleration, c = -i, l = r, u = a ? -c * e.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration : c * e.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration, d = a ? -l * e.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration : l * e.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration, f = Math.sin(e.gimbalPointingDirection) * e.thrustAcceleration, p = Math.cos(e.gimbalPointingDirection) * e.thrustAcceleration;
	e.fixedThrustAcceleration !== 0 && (f += Math.sin(e.pitch) * e.fixedThrustAcceleration, p += Math.cos(e.pitch) * e.fixedThrustAcceleration), n.x = o + f + u, n.y = -t + s + p + d;
}
//#endregion
//#region src/core/physics/step-dynamics.ts
function Vo() {
	return {
		omega0: 0,
		alpha0: 0,
		bodyAccelerationX: 0,
		bodyAccelerationY: 0,
		burnedFraction: 0,
		gimballedThrust: 0,
		airspeed: 0,
		massProperties: Je(),
		gridFinForces: Ni()
	};
}
function Ho(e, t) {
	let { kinematics: n } = e;
	n.pitchRecord.push(n.pitch), n.pitchRecord.shift();
	let r = n.pitchRecord[0];
	n.pitchRateOfChange = e.damage && !Number.isFinite(r) ? n.angularVelocity : (n.pitch - r) / t;
}
function Uo(e) {
	let { kinematics: t } = e;
	t.distanceToPlanetCenter = a + t.altitude, t.orbitalVelocityAtCurrentAltitude = Vr(t.distanceToPlanetCenter);
}
function Wo(e, t) {
	let { kinematics: r, status: i, failures: a, vehicle: o, engines: s } = e;
	r.altitude <= t.height * Math.abs(Math.cos(r.pitch)) * .5 ? (r.speedY < -.5 || t.id === "super-heavy" && r.speedY < 0) && (t.id === "ship" && Math.abs(r.speedX) < 2 && Math.abs(r.speedY) < 10 && Math.abs(r.pitch) < .09 ? (i.landed = !0, r.speedX = 0, r.speedY = 0, r.angularVelocity = 0) : (Vi(e, t, Li.Impact, e.world.environmentTime), a.crashed = !0, r.speedX = 0, r.speedY = 0, r.angularVelocity = 0, r.pitch = n(0), o.propellantMass = 0, s.running.fill(!1), o.rcsRunTimeRemaining = 0)) : (i.landed = !1, i.onTheGround = !1);
}
function Go(e, t, n, r = n.height * Math.abs(Math.cos(e.kinematics.pitch)) * .5) {
	let { kinematics: i, status: a } = e;
	i.altitude > r || i.speedY < -.5 || e.failures.crashed || a.landed || (a.onTheGround = t <= Ur(i.distanceToPlanetCenter), a.onTheGround && (i.speedX = 0, i.speedY = 0, i.angularVelocity = 0));
}
function Ko(e, t, n) {
	let { kinematics: r, forces: i, failures: a, vehicle: o, engines: s } = e;
	(i.perceivedG > 13 || i.surfaceTemperature > 1533 || i.dynamicPressure > 50 || e.damage !== null && (e.damage.terminal.active || !e.damage.hull.valid)) && (Vi(e, t, Hi(e), e.world.environmentTime), a.inFlightBreakUp = !0, r.angularVelocity = 0, o.propellantMass = 0, e.damage || (o.vehicleMass = t.dryMass, qe(0, n.massProperties, t), o.vehicleMomentOfInertia = n.massProperties.momentOfInertia), s.running.fill(!1), s.ignitionCountdown.fill(null), o.rcsRunTimeRemaining = 0, i.rcsThrust = 0);
}
function qo(e) {
	e.vehicle.propellantMass <= 0 && (e.failures.fuelRunOut = !0);
}
function Jo(e, t, n) {
	let { forces: r } = e;
	r.perceivedG_Y = n / w, r.perceivedG_X = t / w, r.perceivedG = Math.sqrt(r.perceivedG_Y ** 2 + r.perceivedG_X ** 2);
}
function Yo(e, t, n, r) {
	let { massProperties: i, gridFinForces: a } = r, o = kr(e.kinematics.speedX, e.kinematics.speedY, H(e.world, e.kinematics.altitude), e.world.gustVertical);
	e.world.updatedFrameCount += 1;
	let s = gr(e.kinematics.altitude);
	if (e.atmosphere.airTemperature = s.airTemperature, e.atmosphere.airPressure = s.airPressure, e.atmosphere.airDensity = s.airDensity, Wo(e, n), e.damage?.terminal.active) {
		Bi(e), r.bodyAccelerationX = r.bodyAccelerationY = r.burnedFraction = r.gimballedThrust = 0;
		return;
	}
	qo(e);
	let c = ca(e, t, n);
	ma(e), e.vehicle.propellantMass <= 0 && e.engines.ignitionCountdown.fill(null), fa(e, t);
	let l = Lr(e.vehicle.frontFinExtension, e.vehicle.aftFinExtension, n);
	e.forces.frontFinEffectiveAreaFraction = l.frontFinEffectiveAreaFraction, e.forces.aftFinEffectiveAreaFraction = l.aftFinEffectiveAreaFraction, e.vehicle.vehicleInFlightMaxArea = l.vehicleInFlightMaxArea, e.forces.crossSectionalArea = Sr(e.kinematics.angleInToTheWind, e.vehicle.vehicleInFlightMaxArea, n), e.kinematics.angleOfMotion = Or(e.kinematics.speedX, e.kinematics.speedY);
	let d = Ar(e.kinematics.speedX, e.kinematics.speedY, H(e.world, e.kinematics.altitude), e.world.gustVertical), f = jr(e.kinematics.pitch, d);
	e.kinematics.angleOfAttack = f.angleOfAttack, e.kinematics.angleInToTheWind = f.angleInToTheWind, e.vehicle.gimbalPointingDirection = oa(e.kinematics.pitch, e.vehicle.gimbalPosition), e.forces.thermalPower = ii(o, e.atmosphere.airDensity, n.diameter / 2, e.kinematics.angleInToTheWind), e.forces.surfaceTemperature = ai(e.forces.thermalPower, si(e.kinematics.altitude, e.atmosphere.airTemperature)), e.forces.dynamicPressure = xr(e.atmosphere.airDensity, o), e.damage && (qi(e, n, e.forces.dynamicPressure * 1e3, Math.abs(Math.sin(e.kinematics.angleInToTheWind))), e.forces.crossSectionalArea = Sr(e.kinematics.angleInToTheWind, e.vehicle.vehicleInFlightMaxArea, n)), Ho(e, t), e.forces.aerodynamicDrag = k(e.atmosphere.airDensity, o, e.forces.crossSectionalArea, Tr(e.kinematics.machSpeed)), e.forces.aerodynamicLift = wr(e.atmosphere.airDensity, o, e.kinematics.angleInToTheWind, e.vehicle.vehicleInFlightMaxArea), e.forces.thrust = na(e.engines.running, e.vehicle.throttleCurrent, e.atmosphere.airPressure, n) * c, e.forces.aerodynamicDragAcceleration = Er(e.forces.aerodynamicDrag, e.vehicle.vehicleMass), e.forces.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration = Er(e.forces.aerodynamicLift, e.vehicle.vehicleMass), e.forces.thrustAcceleration = Er(e.forces.thrust, e.vehicle.vehicleMass), e.forces.twr = e.forces.thrustAcceleration / u;
	let p = ra(e.engines.running, e.atmosphere.airPressure, n), m = e.forces.thrust * p;
	e.damage && (e.forces.paidThrustAccelerationX = e.forces.thrustAcceleration * (p * Math.sin(e.vehicle.gimbalPointingDirection) + (1 - p) * Math.sin(e.kinematics.pitch)), e.forces.paidThrustAccelerationY = e.forces.thrustAcceleration * (p * Math.cos(e.vehicle.gimbalPointingDirection) + (1 - p) * Math.cos(e.kinematics.pitch)));
	let h = e.forces.thrust - m, g = {
		angleOfMotion: d,
		angleOfAttack: e.kinematics.angleOfAttack,
		gimbalPointingDirection: e.vehicle.gimbalPointingDirection,
		aerodynamicDragAcceleration: e.forces.aerodynamicDragAcceleration,
		aerodynamicLiftAcceleration: e.forces.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration,
		thrustAcceleration: Er(m, e.vehicle.vehicleMass),
		fixedThrustAcceleration: Er(h, e.vehicle.vehicleMass),
		pitch: e.kinematics.pitch
	};
	n.gridFins && (Wi(e, n, i), Ji(e, e.atmosphere.airDensity, e.kinematics.speedX - H(e.world, e.kinematics.altitude), e.kinematics.speedY - e.world.gustVertical, e.kinematics.pitch, i, n, a));
	let _ = n.gridFins ? Ro(g) + a.forceX / e.vehicle.vehicleMass : Ro(g), v = n.gridFins ? zo(g, u) + u + a.forceY / e.vehicle.vehicleMass : zo(g, u) + u;
	r.bodyAccelerationX = _, r.bodyAccelerationY = v, r.burnedFraction = c, r.gimballedThrust = m;
}
function Xo(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	Go(e, r, i, a);
	let s = e.kinematics.distanceToPlanetCenter, c = e.kinematics.speedX, l = e.kinematics.speedY, u = n + Kr(s, c, l), d = r + Hr(s, c), f = (e.status.onTheGround || e.status.landed || e.failures.crashed) && d <= 0;
	f && (u = 0, d = 0), Jo(e, f ? -Kr(s, c, l) : n, f ? -Hr(s, c) : r);
	let p = .5 * t * t;
	e.kinematics.altitude += l * t + d * p, e.kinematics.downRangeDistanceNextFrame = e.kinematics.downRangeDistance + c * t + u * p, e.kinematics.downRangeDistanceNextFrame > o ? e.kinematics.downRangeDistance = e.kinematics.downRangeDistanceNextFrame - o : e.kinematics.downRangeDistanceNextFrame < 0 ? e.kinematics.downRangeDistance = e.kinematics.downRangeDistanceNextFrame + o : e.kinematics.downRangeDistance = e.kinematics.downRangeDistanceNextFrame, Uo(e);
	let m = e.kinematics.distanceToPlanetCenter, h = c + u * t, g = l + d * t, _ = f ? 0 : n + Kr(m, h, g), v = f ? 0 : r + Hr(m, h);
	return e.kinematics.speedX = c + .5 * (u + _) * t, e.kinematics.speedY = l + .5 * (d + v) * t, e.kinematics.accelerationX = _, e.kinematics.accelerationY = v, e.kinematics.totalAcceleration = Math.sqrt(_ ** 2 + v ** 2), e.kinematics.trueSpeed = Math.sqrt(e.kinematics.speedX ** 2 + e.kinematics.speedY ** 2), f;
}
function Zo(e, t, n) {
	let r = kr(e.kinematics.speedX, e.kinematics.speedY, H(e.world, e.kinematics.altitude), e.world.gustVertical);
	e.kinematics.machSpeed = r / yr(e.atmosphere.airTemperature), go(e.world, e.rng, e.kinematics.altitude, e.kinematics.speedX, e.kinematics.speedY, t), n.airspeed = r;
}
function Qo(e, t, r, i) {
	let a = .5 * t * t;
	e.kinematics.pitch > Math.PI ? e.kinematics.pitch = n(e.kinematics.pitch - 2 * Math.PI) : e.kinematics.pitch < -Math.PI && (e.kinematics.pitch = n(e.kinematics.pitch + 2 * Math.PI));
	let o = e.kinematics.angularVelocity, s = r ? 0 : e.kinematics.angularAcceleration;
	e.kinematics.pitch = n(e.kinematics.pitch + o * t + s * a), e.kinematics.angularVelocity = o + s * t, i.omega0 = o, i.alpha0 = s;
}
function $o(e, t, r) {
	let { massProperties: i, gridFinForces: a, gimballedThrust: o, burnedFraction: s, airspeed: c } = r;
	e.forces.thrustVectorForce = ia(o, e.vehicle.gimbalPosition), e.forces.frontFinDrag = Fr(e.atmosphere.airDensity, c, e.kinematics.angleOfAttack, e.kinematics.angleInToTheWind, e.forces.frontFinEffectiveAreaFraction, t), e.forces.aftFinDrag = Ir(e.atmosphere.airDensity, c, e.kinematics.angleOfAttack, e.kinematics.angleInToTheWind, e.forces.aftFinEffectiveAreaFraction, t);
	let l = e.vehicle.vehicleMomentOfInertia;
	if (e.forces.thrustVectorAcceleration = Dr(e.forces.thrustVectorForce, i.engineArm, l), e.forces.angularDragAcceleration = Pr(e.atmosphere.airDensity, e.kinematics.angularVelocity, l, i.rCubedIntegral, t), e.forces.frontFinDragAngularAcceleration = Dr(e.forces.frontFinDrag, i.frontFinArm, l), e.forces.aftFinDragAngularAcceleration = Dr(e.forces.aftFinDrag, i.aftFinArm, l), e.forces.rcsThrustAngularAcceleration = Dr(e.forces.rcsThrust, i.rcsArm, l), e.forces.offAxisThrustDifferenceAcceleration = Dr(aa(e.engines.running, e.vehicle.throttleCurrent, e.atmosphere.airPressure, t), i.engineArm, l), t.gridFins && (Ji(e, e.atmosphere.airDensity, e.kinematics.speedX - H(e.world, e.kinematics.altitude), e.kinematics.speedY - e.world.gustVertical, e.kinematics.pitch, i, t, a), e.forces.frontFinDrag = a.lift, e.forces.frontFinDragAngularAcceleration = a.torque / l, e.forces.offAxisThrustDifferenceAcceleration = ha(e.engines.running, e.vehicle.throttleCurrent, e.atmosphere.airPressure, n(e.vehicle.gimbalPosition * .01 * C), t) * s / l), e.damage) {
		let r = e.vehicle.gimbalPosition * .01 * C, a = o * Math.cos(r) + e.forces.thrust - o;
		e.forces.offAxisThrustDifferenceAcceleration = (ha(e.engines.running, e.vehicle.throttleCurrent, e.atmosphere.airPressure, n(r), t) * s + i.centreOfMassX * a) / l;
	}
	return e.forces.thrustVectorAcceleration + e.forces.angularDragAcceleration + e.forces.frontFinDragAngularAcceleration + e.forces.aftFinDragAngularAcceleration + e.forces.rcsThrustAngularAcceleration + e.forces.offAxisThrustDifferenceAcceleration;
}
function es(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	e.kinematics.angularVelocity = n ? 0 : r + .5 * (i + a) * t, e.kinematics.angularAcceleration = n ? 0 : a;
}
function ts(e, t, n, r, i) {
	Wi(e, n, r.massProperties), e.vehicle.vehicleMomentOfInertia = r.massProperties.momentOfInertia, Qo(e, t, i, r);
	let a = $o(e, n, r);
	es(e, t, i, r.omega0, r.alpha0, a);
}

//#region src/core/control/guidance-physics.ts
var ns = .1;
function rs(e) {
	let t = a + e.kinematics.altitude;
	return Math.max(ns, -Hr(t, e.kinematics.speedX));
}
function is(e, t, n = E) {
	return e * P(n.propulsion, "sea-level", t);
}
function as() {
	return {
		fallWork: ks(),
		atmosphere: {
			airTemperature: 0,
			airPressure: 0,
			airDensity: 0
		},
		duration: 0,
		capped: !1,
		inputs: {
			angleOfMotion: n(0),
			angleOfAttack: n(0),
			gimbalPointingDirection: n(0),
			aerodynamicDragAcceleration: 0,
			aerodynamicLiftAcceleration: 0,
			thrustAcceleration: 0,
			fixedThrustAcceleration: 0,
			pitch: n(0)
		},
		acc: {
			x: 0,
			y: 0
		}
	};
}
function os() {
	if (!("isCanonicalBurnPropulsion" in Si)) return !1;
	try {
		let e = Ci;
		return typeof e == "function" && e(e, N, P);
	} catch {
		return !1;
	}
}
function ss() {
	if (!("isCanonicalBurnAero" in br)) return !1;
	try {
		let e = Rr;
		return typeof e == "function" && e(e, Sr);
	} catch {
		return !1;
	}
}
function cs(e, t, r, i, a = E) {
	let o = i.atmosphere;
	hr(e, o);
	let s = t / yr(o.airTemperature);
	return k(o.airDensity, t, Sr(n(0), a.maxArea, a), Tr(s)) / r;
}
var U = .05, ls = 1200;
function us(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	let o = e * N(a.propulsion, "sea-level"), s = U * .5, c = r, l = 0, u = t;
	i.capped = !1;
	for (let t = 0; t < ls; t++) {
		let r = ds(e, c, l, u, i, a), d = l + r * s, f = ds(e, c + (l + d) * .5 * s, d, u + o * s, i, a);
		if (f <= 0) return NaN;
		let p = l + f * U;
		if (p >= n) {
			let e = (n - l) / (p - l);
			return i.duration = (t + e) * U, c + (l + .5 * (n - l)) * e * U;
		}
		c += (l + p) * .5 * U, l = p, u += o * U;
	}
	return i.capped = !0, NaN;
}
function ds(e, t, n, r, i, o) {
	let s = cs(t, n, r, i, o);
	return is(e, i.atmosphere.airPressure, o) / r + s - Ur(a + t);
}
function fs(e, t, n, r, i, a, o, s, c, l) {
	let u = e * (os() ? o : N(a.propulsion, "sea-level")), d = U * .5, f = r, p = 0, m = t;
	i.capped = !1;
	for (let t = 0; t < ls; t++) {
		let r = ms(e, f, p, m, i, a, s, c, l), o = p + r * d, h = ms(e, f + (p + o) * .5 * d, o, m + u * d, i, a, s, c, l);
		if (h <= 0) return NaN;
		let g = p + h * U;
		if (g >= n) {
			let e = (n - p) / (g - p);
			return i.duration = (t + e) * U, f + (p + .5 * (n - p)) * e * U;
		}
		f += (p + g) * .5 * U, p = g, m += u * U;
	}
	return i.capped = !0, NaN;
}
function ps(e, t, r, i, a, o) {
	let s = i.atmosphere;
	hr(e, s);
	let c = t / yr(s.airTemperature), l = k, u = s.airDensity;
	return l(u, t, ss() ? o : Sr(n(0), a.maxArea, a), Tr(c)) / r;
}
function ms(e, t, n, r, i, o, s, c, l) {
	let u = ps(t, n, r, i, o, l), d = i.atmosphere.airPressure, f;
	if (os()) {
		let t = Math.max(0, d) * 1e3;
		f = e * Math.max(0, s - t * c);
	} else f = is(e, d, o);
	return f / r + u - Ur(a + t);
}
var hs = 24, gs = 1;
function _s(e, t, n, r, i = E) {
	if (e <= 0 || t <= 0) return Infinity;
	let o = t + e * N(i.propulsion, "sea-level") * U + gs, s = is(e, T / 1e3, i) / o - Ur(a + r);
	return s <= 0 ? Infinity : r + Math.max(0, n) ** 2 / (2 * s);
}
function vs(e, t, r, i, o, s = E, c = s.dryMass) {
	if (e <= 0 || t <= 0 || !(c > 0 && c <= t)) return null;
	if (r <= 0) return i;
	let l = e * N(s.propulsion, "sea-level"), u = is(e, T / 1e3, s) / t - Ur(a);
	if (u <= 0) return null;
	let d = s === bi && os() && ss(), f = d ? N(s.propulsion, "sea-level") : 0, p = d ? f * s.propulsion.standardGravity * s.propulsion.seaLevel.ispVacuum : 0, m = d ? (p - s.propulsion.seaLevel.thrustSeaLevel) / s.propulsion.referencePressurePa : 0, h = d ? Sr(n(0), s.maxArea, s) : 0, g = Math.max(t - r / u * l, c), _ = d ? fs(e, g, r, i, o, s, f, p, m, h) : us(e, g, r, i, o, s);
	if (Number.isNaN(_)) return null;
	let v = t - l * o.duration - g;
	if (v < 0) return null;
	if (v < gs) return _;
	let y = t - l * o.duration, b = NaN, x = 0;
	for (let n = 0; n < hs; n++) {
		let a = Number.isNaN(b) ? n === 0 ? y : (g + y) / 2 : y - b * (y - g) / (b - v), c = d ? fs(e, a, r, i, o, s, f, p, m, h) : us(e, a, r, i, o, s);
		if (o.capped) return null;
		let u = Number.isNaN(c) ? NaN : t - l * o.duration - a;
		if (!Number.isNaN(u) && Math.abs(u) < gs) return c;
		if (!Number.isNaN(u) && u > 0 ? (g = a, v = u, _ = c, x === 1 && !Number.isNaN(b) && (b *= .5), x = 1) : (y = a, b = u, x === -1 && (v *= .5), x = -1), y - g < gs) break;
	}
	return _;
}
function ys() {
	return {
		reached: !1,
		time: NaN,
		downRange: 0
	};
}
var bs = .25, xs = 4e3, Ss = 2;
function Cs(e, t, r, i, o, s, c, l, d, f = 0, p = 0, m, h) {
	let { inputs: g, acc: _ } = l, v = a + e, y = l.atmosphere;
	hr(Math.max(e, 0), y);
	let b = t - uo(c, e), x = f === 0 ? b : b - f, S = p === 0 ? r : r - p, C = Math.sqrt(x * x + S * S), w = Math.atan2(x, S), ee = Mr(i, w), T = Nr(ee);
	if (m?.damage) {
		let e = h?.controlModel ?? A(d).controls, t = .5 * y.airDensity * C ** 2;
		if (h && h.zeroControlArea !== null && Number.isFinite(t * h.zeroControlColumnArea * Ss)) zn(m.damage, e, t, Number.isFinite(T) ? 0 : NaN, Ds), s = h.zeroControlArea;
		else {
			let n = d.gridFins ? (m.vehicle.frontFinExtension - 50) / 50 * d.gridFins.maxAngle : m.vehicle.frontFinExtension * .01 * re, r = m.vehicle.aftFinExtension * .01 * re;
			if (Bn(m.damage, e, t, Math.abs(Math.sin(T)), n, r, Ds), s = d.maxArea + 1.8 * (Ds.frontArea + Ds.aftArea), h && n === 0 && r === 0) {
				h.zeroControlArea = s, h.zeroControlColumnArea = 0;
				for (let t of e.columns) h.zeroControlColumnArea = Math.max(h.zeroControlColumnArea, t.area);
			}
		}
	}
	let te = Sr(n(T), s, d), ne = C / yr(y.airTemperature);
	g.angleOfMotion = n(w), g.angleOfAttack = n(ee), g.aerodynamicDragAcceleration = k(y.airDensity, C, te, Tr(ne)) / o, g.aerodynamicLiftAcceleration = wr(y.airDensity, C, n(T), s) / o, Bo(g, u, _), _.x += Kr(v, t, r), _.y = _.y + u + Hr(v, t);
}
var ws = Je(), Ts = Ni(), Es = ji(), Ds = Rn(12);
function Os(e, t, n, r) {
	let i = e.kinematics;
	e.damage && F(e, n, Es, ws);
	let a = e.damage ? Es.totalMass : e.vehicle.vehicleMass;
	if (!(a > 0)) {
		r.acc.x = r.acc.y = 0;
		return;
	}
	Cs(i.altitude, i.speedX, i.speedY, t, a, e.vehicle.vehicleInFlightMaxArea, e.world.wind, r, n, e.world.gust, e.world.gustVertical, e), n.gridFins && (e.damage || qe(e.vehicle.propellantMass, ws, n), Ji(e, r.atmosphere.airDensity, i.speedX - uo(e.world.wind, i.altitude) - e.world.gust, i.speedY - e.world.gustVertical, t, ws, n, Ts), r.acc.x += Ts.forceX / a, r.acc.y += Ts.forceY / a);
}
function ks() {
	return {
		state: null,
		model: E,
		groundAltitude: 0,
		pitch: n(0),
		mass: 0,
		maxArea: 0,
		referenceWind: 0,
		zeroControlArea: null,
		zeroControlColumnArea: 0,
		controlModel: null,
		h: 0,
		x: 0,
		vx: 0,
		vy: 0,
		steps: 0,
		done: !0,
		result: ys()
	};
}
function As(e, t, n, r, i) {
	t.damage && F(t, r, Es), e.state = t, e.model = r, e.groundAltitude = n, e.pitch = i, e.mass = t.damage ? Es.totalMass : t.vehicle.vehicleMass, e.maxArea = t.vehicle.vehicleInFlightMaxArea, e.referenceWind = t.world.wind, e.zeroControlArea = null, e.zeroControlColumnArea = 0, e.controlModel = t.damage ? A(r).controls : null, e.h = t.kinematics.altitude, e.x = 0, e.vx = t.kinematics.speedX, e.vy = t.kinematics.speedY, e.steps = 0, e.done = !(e.mass > 0), e.result.reached = !1, e.result.time = NaN, e.result.downRange = e.done ? NaN : 0;
}
function js(e, t, n = E, r = e.kinematics.pitch) {
	let i = ks();
	return As(i, e, t, n, r), i;
}
function Ms(e, t, n) {
	if (e.done) return 0;
	let r = e.state, i = e.model, a = e.pitch, o = e.mass, s = e.maxArea, c = e.referenceWind, l = n.acc, u = bs * .5, d = e.h, f = e.x, p = e.vx, m = e.vy, h = e.steps, g = 0, _ = Math.min(Math.floor(t), xs - h);
	for (let t = 0; t < _; t++) {
		Cs(d, p, m, a, o, s, c, n, i, 0, 0, r, e);
		let t = p + l.x * u, _ = m + l.y * u;
		Cs(d + m * u, t, _, a, o, s, c, n, i, 0, 0, r, e);
		let v = p + l.x * bs, y = m + l.y * bs, b = d + _ * bs, x = f + t * bs, S = h;
		if (h++, g++, b <= e.groundAltitude) {
			let t = (d - e.groundAltitude) / (d - b);
			e.result.reached = !0, e.result.time = (S + t) * bs, e.result.downRange = f + (x - f) * t, d = b, f = x, p = v, m = y, e.done = !0;
			break;
		}
		d = b, f = x, p = v, m = y;
	}
	return e.h = d, e.x = f, e.vx = p, e.vy = m, e.steps = h, e.result.reached || (e.result.downRange = f), h >= 4e3 && (e.done = !0), g;
}
function Ns(e, t, n, r, i = E, a = e.kinematics.pitch) {
	let o = n.fallWork;
	As(o, e, t, i, a), Ms(o, xs, n), r.reached = o.result.reached, r.time = o.result.time, r.downRange = o.result.downRange, o.state = null;
}

//#region src/core/control/primitives.ts
var Ps = Je(), W = ji(), Fs = Rn(12), Is = Ni();
function Ls(e, t) {
	let n = e - t;
	return n < -Math.PI ? n = Math.PI * 2 + n : n > Math.PI && (n = -(Math.PI * 2 - n)), n;
}
function Rs(e, t, n, r = t, i = E) {
	let a = z(e, n, i), o = ra(e, n, i);
	return o === 1 ? a * Math.cos(t) : a * o * Math.cos(t) + a * (1 - o) * Math.cos(r);
}
function zs(e) {
	return Math.sqrt(35 / e * 2e3);
}
function G(e, t, r, i = E) {
	let { kinematics: a, forces: o, status: s, vehicle: c, autopilot: l } = e, u = Ls(a.pitch, t);
	e.damage ? F(e, i, W, Ps) : qe(c.propellantMass, Ps, i);
	let d = !e.damage || W.engineSupportAvailable, f = (-u / r ** 2 - 2 * a.angularVelocity / r - (d ? o.offAxisThrustDifferenceAcceleration : 0)) * (e.damage ? W.momentOfInertia : c.vehicleMomentOfInertia), p = 0, m = () => {
		if (Math.abs(u) > .1) {
			let e = f / Ps.rcsArm;
			e > 0 ? e > 8e5 ? p = 100 : l.rcsThrustCommand = e : e < 0 ? e < -8e5 ? p = -100 : l.rcsThrustCommand = e : p = 0, l.pitchControl = p;
		}
	}, h = d ? o.thrust * ra(e.engines.running, e.atmosphere.airPressure, i) : 0;
	h > 0 ? (() => {
		let e = f / Ps.engineArm / h;
		e >= 1 ? p = 100 : e <= -1 ? p = -100 : (p = Math.asin(e) * 100 / C, p >= 100 ? p = 100 : p <= -100 && (p = -100)), s.rcsActive && (p *= .98), l.pitchControl = p;
	})() : s.finActive ? (() => {
		let t = kr(a.speedX, a.speedY, H(e.world, a.altitude), e.world.gustVertical);
		if (e.damage) {
			let r = 0, o = 0, c = .5 * e.atmosphere.airDensity * t ** 2;
			if (i.gridFins) for (let t = -1; t <= 1; t += 2) Ji(e, e.atmosphere.airDensity, a.speedX - H(e.world, a.altitude), a.speedY - e.world.gustVertical, a.pitch, Ps, i, Is, n(t * i.gridFins.maxAngle)), Is.torque * f > 0 && Math.abs(Is.torque) > Math.abs(r) && (r = Is.torque, o = t * 100);
			else {
				let t = Math.abs(Math.sin(a.angleInToTheWind)), n = a.angleOfAttack < 0 ? -1 : 1;
				for (let a = 0; a < 2; a++) {
					let s = a === 0;
					Bn(e.damage, A(i).controls, c, t, s ? re : 0, s ? 0 : re, Fs);
					let l = c * 2 * t * n * (Fs.frontArea * Ps.frontFinArm - Fs.aftArea * Ps.aftFinArm);
					l * f > 0 && Math.abs(l) > Math.abs(r) && (r = l, o = (s ? n : -n) * 100);
				}
			}
			p = r === 0 ? 0 : o * Math.min(1, Math.abs(f / r)), s.rcsActive && (p *= .99, m()), l.pitchControl = p;
			return;
		}
		if (f > 0) {
			let n = k(e.atmosphere.airDensity, t, i.frontFinArea, 2) * Math.sin(re) * Ps.frontFinArm + k(e.atmosphere.airDensity, t, i.aftFinArea, 2) * Ps.aftFinArm;
			p = f / n * 100, p >= 100 && (p = 100);
		} else if (f < 0) {
			let n = k(e.atmosphere.airDensity, t, i.aftFinArea, 2) * Math.sin(re) * Ps.aftFinArm + k(e.atmosphere.airDensity, t, i.frontFinArea, 2) * Ps.frontFinArm;
			p = f / n * 100, p <= -100 && (p = -100);
		} else p = 0;
		s.rcsActive && (p *= .99, m()), l.pitchControl = p;
	})() : m();
}
function Bs(e, t, n = E) {
	Vs(e, t * rs(e), n);
}
function Vs(e, t, n = E) {
	let { vehicle: r, engines: i } = e;
	e.damage && F(e, n, W);
	let a = !e.damage || W.engineSupportAvailable, o = t * (e.damage ? W.totalMass : r.vehicleMass) / (a ? z(i.running, e.atmosphere.airPressure, n) : 0) * 100;
	Number.isNaN(o) && (o = 40), o > 100 ? o = 100 : o < 40 && (o = 40), r.throttle = o;
}
function Hs(e, t, n = E) {
	let { vehicle: r, engines: i } = e;
	e.damage && F(e, n, W);
	let a = !e.damage || W.engineSupportAvailable, o = t * (e.damage ? W.totalMass : r.vehicleMass) * rs(e) / (a ? Rs(i.running, r.gimbalPointingDirection, e.atmosphere.airPressure, e.kinematics.pitch, n) : 0) * 100;
	Number.isNaN(o) && (o = 40), o > 100 ? o = 100 : o < 40 && (o = 40), r.throttle = o;
}
function Us(e, t, r, i, a) {
	let o = e.kinematics.speedX - t;
	o < 0 ? (G(e, r, a), -o < i && G(e, n(r * -o / i), a)) : (G(e, n(-r), a), o < i && G(e, n(-r * o / i), a));
}
function Ws(e, t, n, r) {
	let i = e.kinematics.speedY - t;
	i < 0 ? (Hs(e, r), -i < n && Hs(e, 1 - i / n)) : (Hs(e, 0), i < n && Hs(e, 1 - i / n));
}
function Gs(e, t, n, r, i = E) {
	let a = t - e.kinematics.trueSpeed;
	a < 0 ? Bs(e, 0, i) : (Bs(e, r, i), a < n && Bs(e, 1 + a / n, i));
}
function Ks(e, t, n) {
	return e / (t * n);
}
function qs(e, t, r, i) {
	let { status: a, kinematics: o, autopilot: s } = e;
	a.finActive || i(e), s.horizontalAccelerationByAeroBreakingCorrectionAngle = Math.abs(o.accelerationX) > Math.abs(t) ? n(s.horizontalAccelerationByAeroBreakingCorrectionAngle - De * r) : n(s.horizontalAccelerationByAeroBreakingCorrectionAngle + De * r), s.horizontalAccelerationByAeroBreakingCorrectionAngle > Ee ? s.horizontalAccelerationByAeroBreakingCorrectionAngle = Ee : s.horizontalAccelerationByAeroBreakingCorrectionAngle < 0 && (s.horizontalAccelerationByAeroBreakingCorrectionAngle = n(0)), t < 0 ? G(e, n(s.horizontalAccelerationByAeroBreakingCorrectionAngle - Math.PI / 2), 1.5) : G(e, n(-s.horizontalAccelerationByAeroBreakingCorrectionAngle + Math.PI / 2), 1.5);
}
function Js(e, t, n = E) {
	let { engines: r } = e;
	if (F(e, n, W), !W.engineSupportAvailable || !W.hasMass) return;
	let i = r.running;
	if (Ks(ta(i, e.atmosphere.airPressure, n), W.totalMass, rs(e)) > 1) {
		let r = $i(i, n);
		if (r === 0) return;
		let a = r === 3 ? 0 : r === 2 ? i[0] && i[1] ? 0 : i[1] && i[2] ? 1 : 2 : i[0] ? 0 : i[1] ? 1 : 2;
		if (i[a] && n.engines[a]?.kind === "sea-level") t(e, a);
		else for (let r = 0; r < n.engines.length; r++) if (i[r] && n.engines[r].kind === "sea-level") {
			t(e, r);
			break;
		}
	}
}

//#region src/core/physics/tower-catch.ts
function Ys() {
	return {
		x: 0,
		altitude: 0,
		speedX: 0,
		speedY: 0
	};
}
function Xs(e, t, n) {
	let r = e.kinematics, i = M.lugStation - t.height / 2;
	n.x = r.downRangeDistance + i * Math.sin(r.pitch), n.altitude = r.altitude + i * Math.cos(r.pitch), n.speedX = r.speedX + i * Math.cos(r.pitch) * r.angularVelocity, n.speedY = r.speedY - i * Math.sin(r.pitch) * r.angularVelocity;
}
var Zs = Ys(), Qs = Ys(), K = {
	fraction: 0,
	pitch: 0,
	x: 0,
	speedX: 0,
	speedY: 0
};
function $s(e, t, n) {
	if (n.id !== "super-heavy" || t.status.landed) return !1;
	let r = t.failures;
	if (r.crashed || r.inFlightBreakUp || r.fuelRunOut) return !1;
	let i = t.kinematics, a = n.height * Math.abs(Math.cos(i.pitch)) / 2 + n.diameter * Math.abs(Math.sin(i.pitch)) / 2;
	if (i.altitude <= a || (Xs(e, n, Zs), Xs(t, n, Qs), !(Zs.altitude > M.planeAltitude && Qs.altitude <= M.planeAltitude))) return !1;
	let o = (Zs.altitude - M.planeAltitude) / (Zs.altitude - Qs.altitude), s = e.kinematics, c = Math.atan2(Math.sin(i.pitch - s.pitch), Math.cos(i.pitch - s.pitch));
	return K.fraction = o, K.pitch = s.pitch + c * o, K.x = s.downRangeDistance + (i.downRangeDistance - s.downRangeDistance) * o + (M.lugStation - n.height / 2) * Math.sin(K.pitch), K.speedX = Zs.speedX + (Qs.speedX - Zs.speedX) * o, K.speedY = Zs.speedY + (Qs.speedY - Zs.speedY) * o, Number.isFinite(K.x) && Number.isFinite(K.pitch) && Number.isFinite(K.speedX) && Number.isFinite(K.speedY) && Math.abs(K.x - d) <= M.halfWidth && Math.abs(K.speedX) <= M.maxLateralSpeed && K.speedY < 0 && K.speedY >= -M.maxDownSpeed && Math.abs(K.pitch) <= M.maxPitch;
}
function ec(e, t, r) {
	if (!$s(e, t, r)) return !1;
	let i = t.kinematics, o = e.kinematics;
	return i.downRangeDistance = o.downRangeDistance + (i.downRangeDistance - o.downRangeDistance) * K.fraction, i.downRangeDistanceNextFrame = i.downRangeDistance, i.pitch = n(K.pitch), i.altitude = M.planeAltitude - (M.lugStation - r.height / 2) * Math.cos(i.pitch), i.distanceToPlanetCenter = a + i.altitude, i.speedX = i.speedY = i.trueSpeed = i.angularVelocity = 0, i.accelerationX = i.accelerationY = i.totalAcceleration = i.angularAcceleration = 0, t.status.landed = !0, t.status.onTheGround = !1, t.engines.running.fill(!1), t.engines.ignitionCountdown.fill(null), t.forces.thrust = t.forces.thrustAcceleration = t.forces.twr = t.forces.rcsThrust = 0, t.autopilot.pitchControl = t.autopilot.rcsThrustCommand = 0, !0;
}

//#region src/core/control/booster-arrival.ts
var q = ji(), tc = .3;
function nc() {
	return {
		pitch: n(0),
		throttle: 100,
		requiredX: 0,
		requiredY: 0,
		deliveredX: 0,
		deliveredY: 0
	};
}
function rc(e, t, r, i, a) {
	F(e, i, q);
	let o = e.kinematics, s = q.totalMass;
	if (!q.hasMass) {
		a.pitch = n(0), a.throttle = 100, a.requiredX = a.requiredY = a.deliveredX = a.deliveredY = 0;
		return;
	}
	let c = ra(e.engines.running, e.atmosphere.airPressure, i), l = e.forces.thrust / s, u = e.damage ? e.forces.paidThrustAccelerationX : l * (c * Math.sin(e.vehicle.gimbalPointingDirection) + (1 - c) * Math.sin(o.pitch)), d = e.damage ? e.forces.paidThrustAccelerationY : l * (c * Math.cos(e.vehicle.gimbalPointingDirection) + (1 - c) * Math.cos(o.pitch));
	a.requiredX = t - (o.accelerationX - u), a.requiredY = r - (o.accelerationY - d), a.pitch = n(Math.max(-.3, Math.min(tc, Math.atan2(a.requiredX, Math.max(0, a.requiredY)))));
	let f = Math.max(0, a.requiredY) / Math.cos(a.pitch), p = q.engineSupportAvailable ? z(e.engines.running, e.atmosphere.airPressure, i) / s : 0;
	a.throttle = p > 0 ? Math.max(40, Math.min(100, 100 * f / p)) : 100, a.deliveredX = p * a.throttle * .01 * Math.sin(a.pitch), a.deliveredY = p * a.throttle * .01 * Math.cos(a.pitch);
}
var ic = as(), J = nc();
function ac(e, t, r, i, a, o) {
	return Os(e, n(o), i, ic), J.requiredX = t - ic.acc.x, J.requiredY = r - ic.acc.y, J.pitch = n(o), J.throttle = a > 0 ? Math.max(40, Math.min(100, 100 * Math.max(0, J.requiredY) / (a * Math.cos(o)))) : 100, J.deliveredX = a * J.throttle * .01 * Math.sin(o), J.deliveredY = a * J.throttle * .01 * Math.cos(o), J.deliveredX - J.requiredX;
}
function oc(e, t) {
	let n = (J.deliveredX - J.requiredX) ** 2 + (J.deliveredY - J.requiredY) ** 2;
	return n >= t ? t : (Object.assign(e, J), n);
}
function sc(e, t, n, r, i, a = tc) {
	F(e, r, q);
	let o = q.engineSupportAvailable && q.hasMass ? z(e.engines.running, e.atmosphere.airPressure, r) / q.totalMass : 0, s = Math.max(0, Math.min(tc, a)), c = -s, l = ac(e, t, n, r, o, c), u = oc(i, Infinity);
	for (let a = 1; a <= 16; a++) {
		let d = -s + 2 * s * a / 16, f = ac(e, t, n, r, o, d);
		if (u = oc(i, u), l * f < 0) {
			let a = c, s = d, f = l;
			for (let c = 0; c < 12; c++) {
				let c = (a + s) / 2, l = ac(e, t, n, r, o, c);
				u = oc(i, u), f * l <= 0 ? s = c : (a = c, f = l);
			}
		}
		c = d, l = f;
	}
}
function cc(e, t, n) {
	if (F(e, n, q), !q.engineSupportAvailable || !q.hasMass) return 100;
	let r = ra(e.engines.running, e.atmosphere.airPressure, n), i = r * Math.cos(e.vehicle.gimbalPointingDirection) + (1 - r) * Math.cos(e.kinematics.pitch), a = e.damage ? e.forces.paidThrustAccelerationY : e.forces.thrust / q.totalMass * i, o = e.kinematics.accelerationY - a;
	F(e, n, q);
	let s = q.engineSupportAvailable && q.hasMass ? z(e.engines.running, e.atmosphere.airPressure, n) / q.totalMass : 0;
	return s <= 0 || i <= 0 ? 100 : Math.max(40, Math.min(100, 100 * Math.max(0, t - o) / (s * i)));
}
function lc() {
	return {
		x: 0,
		height: 0,
		vx: 0,
		vy: 0,
		time: 0,
		ax: 0,
		ay: 0,
		bodyAX: 0,
		bodyAY: 0,
		centreAX: 0,
		centreAY: 0,
		lateralFeasible: !0
	};
}
var uc = Ys(), dc = Object.freeze([
	!0,
	!0,
	!0
]), fc = nc();
function pc(e, t, n, r) {
	F(e, n, q);
	let i = q.engineSupportAvailable && q.hasMass && dc.every((t, n) => !e.engines.failed[n]), o = q.totalMass;
	Xs(e, n, uc), r.x = uc.x - d, r.height = uc.altitude - M.planeAltitude, r.vx = uc.speedX, r.vy = uc.speedY;
	let s = e.autopilot;
	if (s.boosterArrivalTime === void 0) {
		let e = Math.max(0, r.height), t = Math.max(0, -r.vy), c = 2 * e / (t + 2), l = (i ? z(dc, T / 1e3, n) / o : 0) + Hr(a + M.bodyCentreAltitude, 0), u = l > 0 ? 6 * e / (Math.sqrt((t + 4) ** 2 + 6 * l * e) + t + 4) : 60;
		s.boosterArrivalTime = Math.max(.5, Math.min(60, Math.max(c, u)));
	}
	s.boosterArrivalTime = Math.max(0, s.boosterArrivalTime - t), r.time = Math.max(.25, s.boosterArrivalTime), r.ax = -6 * r.x / r.time ** 2 - 4 * r.vx / r.time, r.ay = -6 * r.height / r.time ** 2 - 4 * r.vy / r.time + 4 / r.time;
	let c = e.kinematics, l = M.lugStation - n.height / 2;
	r.bodyAX = r.ax - l * (Math.cos(c.pitch) * c.angularAcceleration - Math.sin(c.pitch) * c.angularVelocity ** 2), r.bodyAY = r.ay + l * (Math.sin(c.pitch) * c.angularAcceleration + Math.cos(c.pitch) * c.angularVelocity ** 2), r.centreAX = -6 * (c.downRangeDistance - d) / r.time ** 2 - 4 * c.speedX / r.time, r.centreAY = -6 * (c.altitude - M.bodyCentreAltitude) / r.time ** 2 - 4 * c.speedY / r.time + 4 / r.time;
	let u = i ? z(dc, e.atmosphere.airPressure, n) / o * Math.sin(tc) : 0;
	rc(e, r.ax, r.ay, n, fc);
	let f = fc.requiredX;
	rc(e, 6 * r.x / r.time ** 2 + 2 * r.vx / r.time, 6 * r.height / r.time ** 2 + 2 * r.vy / r.time - 8 / r.time, n, fc), r.lateralFeasible = i && Number.isFinite(f) && Number.isFinite(fc.requiredX) && Math.abs(f) <= u && Math.abs(fc.requiredX) <= u;
}

//#region src/core/control/booster-forecast.ts
function mc() {
	return {
		reached: !1,
		rangeError: 0,
		time: 0,
		fuel: 0,
		speedX: 0,
		speedY: 0,
		pitch: 0,
		steps: 0,
		ignitionDraws: 0,
		failed: !1
	};
}
var hc = Ys(), gc = Ys(), _c = lc();
function Y(e) {
	let t = e * 120, n = Math.round(t);
	return e === n / 120 ? n : Math.ceil(t);
}
function vc(e) {
	return Y(e) / 120;
}
function yc(e, t) {
	return Math.max(0, Y(e) - t.boostSteps - 6 * t.steadySteps) / 120;
}
function bc(e, t, n = 0) {
	let r = V(e);
	if (delete r.autopilot.boosterPrediction, delete r.autopilot.boosterForecastHandoff, r.autopilot.boosterPhase === "align-boost" || r.autopilot.boosterPhase === "boostback" && n <= 0 || !r.autopilot.boosterPhase) {
		r.autopilot.boosterPhase = "coast";
		for (let e = 0; e < r.engines.running.length; e++) pa(r, e);
	}
	return r.autopilot.boosterCoastPitch = t, {
		state: r,
		initialTime: r.autopilot.boosterFallTime ?? 900,
		initialDraws: r.rng.counters.ignitionFailure,
		burnRemaining: vc(n),
		burnTicks: Y(n),
		cutoffClock: r.world.environmentTime,
		done: !1,
		result: mc()
	};
}
function xc(e, t, n, r, i, a) {
	let o = e.result, s = e.state, c = 0, l = e.reusePrefix, u = e.burnRemaining;
	l && (u = yc(u, l)), l && l.origin === e.origin && l.advance === n && l.policy === r && l.model === i && e.step === void 0 && e.initialTime === l.initialTime && s.autopilot.boosterCoastPitch === l.coastPitch && u > 0 && o.steps === 0 && (s = V(l.state), s.autopilot.boosterForecastBurn = !0, o.time = l.time, o.steps = l.steps, e.prefix = l, e.burnRemaining = u, e.burnTicks = Math.round(u * 120), e.cutoffClock = l.cutoffClock, e.boostSteps = l.boostSteps, e.steadySteps = l.steadySteps), delete e.reusePrefix;
	for (let l = 0; l < t && !e.done; l++) {
		Xs(s, i, hc);
		let t = s.autopilot.boosterPhase, l = t === "align-boost" || t === "boostback" || t === "entry" || t === "terminal", u = t === "boostback" && !ci.every((e) => s.engines.running[e]), f = u || t === "entry" && !(s.autopilot.boosterEntryCentreOnly ? j : ci).every((e) => s.engines.running[e]) || t === "terminal" && !j.every((e) => s.engines.running[e]), p = t === "align-boost" || f || t === "terminal" && s.autopilot.boosterArrivalTime === void 0 ? 1 / 120 : e.step ?? (e.stopAtHandoff && l || s.kinematics.altitude < 2e3 ? .05 : .25), m = t === "boostback" || !e.stopAtHandoff && e.burnRemaining > 0, h = m && e.burnTicks > 0 ? e.burnTicks < 6 ? 1 / 120 : Math.min(p, .05) : p;
		e.burnRemaining > 0 && (s.autopilot.boosterForecastBurn = !0), s.autopilot.boosterFallTime = Math.max(2, e.initialTime - o.time);
		let g = a?.eligible(s, h), _ = g ? V(s) : void 0, v;
		if (s = n(s, h, g ? (e, t, n) => {
			v = V(e), r(e, t, n);
		} : r, i), o.steps++, c++, _ && a.paid(_, v, s, h), u && (e.boostSteps = (e.boostSteps ?? 0) + 1), t === "boostback" && !u && h === .05 && (e.steadySteps = (e.steadySteps ?? 0) + 1), t === "align-boost" || m) for (let t = 0; t < Math.round(h * 120); t++) e.cutoffClock += 1 / 120;
		if (m && e.burnTicks > 0 && (e.burnTicks = Math.max(0, e.burnTicks - Math.round(h * 120)), e.burnRemaining = e.burnTicks / 120), e.readyHandoff && e.step === void 0 && e.origin && (t === "align-boost" && s.autopilot.boosterPhase === "boostback" || u && e.burnRemaining > 0 && ci.every((e) => s.engines.running[e]) || t === "boostback" && !u && h === .05)) {
			e.prefix = {
				origin: e.origin,
				state: V(s),
				time: o.time + h,
				steps: o.steps,
				advance: n,
				policy: r,
				model: i,
				coastPitch: s.autopilot.boosterCoastPitch,
				initialTime: e.initialTime,
				boostSteps: e.boostSteps ?? 0,
				steadySteps: e.steadySteps ?? 0,
				cutoffClock: e.cutoffClock
			}, u && (e.startupPrefix = e.prefix);
			let t = e.prefix.steadySteps;
			t > 0 && (e.rollingPrefixes = Tc(e.rollingPrefixes, [e.prefix])), t > 0 && !(t & t - 1) && !(e.checkpoints ?? []).some((e) => e.steadySteps === t) && (e.checkpoints = [...e.checkpoints ?? [], e.prefix]);
		}
		if ((m || e.stopAtHandoff && s.autopilot.boosterPhase === "boostback") && e.burnRemaining === 0) {
			delete s.autopilot.boosterForecastBurn, s.autopilot.boosterPhase = "coast";
			for (let e = 0; e < s.engines.running.length; e++) pa(s, e);
			e.shutdownAt = e.cutoffClock, e.stopAtCutoff && (e.done = !0);
		}
		Xs(s, i, gc);
		let y = hc.altitude > M.planeAltitude && gc.altitude <= M.planeAltitude;
		if (o.time += h, e.stopAtHandoff && s.autopilot.boosterPhase === "terminal" && (!e.readyHandoff || t === "terminal" && j.every((e) => s.engines.running[e]))) {

function il(e, t, n, r, i = !1) {

function sl(e, t) {

//#region src/core/physics/body-reference.ts
function Yl(e, t, n, r) {
	let i = Math.sin(e.pitch), o = Math.cos(e.pitch), s = o * t + i * n, c = -i * t + o * n, l = e.angularVelocity, u = e.angularAcceleration;
	r.downRangeDistance = e.downRangeDistance + s, r.downRangeDistanceNextFrame = r.downRangeDistance, r.altitude = e.altitude + c, r.speedX = e.speedX + l * c, r.speedY = e.speedY - l * s, r.accelerationX = e.accelerationX + u * c - l ** 2 * s, r.accelerationY = e.accelerationY - u * s - l ** 2 * c, r.pitch = e.pitch, r.angularVelocity = l, r.angularAcceleration = u, r.distanceToPlanetCenter = a + r.altitude, r.orbitalVelocityAtCurrentAltitude = Vr(r.distanceToPlanetCenter), r.trueSpeed = Math.hypot(r.speedX, r.speedY), r.totalAcceleration = Math.hypot(r.accelerationX, r.accelerationY);
}
//#endregion
//#region src/core/mission-free-flight.ts
var $ = Vo(), Xl = { ...E }, Zl = { ...bi };
function Ql(e, t, n, r) {
	let i = e.kinematics, o = Math.sin(i.pitch), s = Math.cos(i.pitch);
	e.damage ? (t.pitch = i.pitch, t.angularVelocity = i.angularVelocity, t.angularAcceleration = i.angularAcceleration, Yl(t, -r, -n, i)) : (i.downRangeDistance = t.downRangeDistance - n * o, i.downRangeDistanceNextFrame = i.downRangeDistance, i.altitude = t.altitude - n * s, i.distanceToPlanetCenter = a + i.altitude, i.orbitalVelocityAtCurrentAltitude = Vr(i.distanceToPlanetCenter), i.speedX = t.speedX - n * i.angularVelocity * s, i.speedY = t.speedY + n * i.angularVelocity * o, i.accelerationX = t.accelerationX - n * (i.angularAcceleration * s - i.angularVelocity ** 2 * o), i.accelerationY = t.accelerationY + n * (i.angularAcceleration * o + i.angularVelocity ** 2 * s), i.totalAcceleration = Math.hypot(i.accelerationX, i.accelerationY)), i.trueSpeed = Math.hypot(i.speedX, i.speedY), i.machSpeed = kr(i.speedX, i.speedY, H(e.world, i.altitude), e.world.gustVertical) / yr(e.atmosphere.airTemperature);
}
function $l(e, t, n, r, i) {
	let o = eo(e);
	if (r.id === "super-heavy" && e.status.landed) return o.damage && ti(o.damage, A(r).debris, t), o.engines.running.fill(!1), o.engines.ignitionCountdown.fill(null), o.world.environmentTime += t, o.world.updatedFrameCount += 1, o;
	if (r.id === "super-heavy" && (n.pitchControl !== void 0 || n.throttle !== void 0) && ga(o.autopilot), o.damage?.terminal.active) return ti(o.damage, A(r).debris, t), Bi(o), o.world.environmentTime += t, o.world.updatedFrameCount++, o;
	if (Yo(o, t, r, $), o.damage && ti(o.damage, A(r).debris, t), o.damage?.terminal.active) return o.engines.running.fill(!1), o.engines.ignitionCountdown.fill(null), o.world.environmentTime += t, o;
	Wi(o, r, $.massProperties);
	let s = o.kinematics, c = (o.damage ? $.massProperties.centreOfMass : Ue(o.vehicle.propellantMass, r)) - r.height / 2, l = o.damage ? $.massProperties.centreOfMassX : 0, u = Math.sin(s.pitch), d = Math.cos(s.pitch), f = {
		...s,
		downRangeDistance: s.downRangeDistance + c * u,
		altitude: s.altitude + c * d,
		speedX: s.speedX + c * s.angularVelocity * d,
		speedY: s.speedY - c * s.angularVelocity * u
	};
	o.damage && Yl(s, l, c, f), f.distanceToPlanetCenter = a + f.altitude;
	let p = r.id === "ship" ? Xl : Zl;
	p.height = r.height + 2 * c * Math.sign(d);
	let m = Xo({
		kinematics: f,
		forces: o.forces,
		status: o.status,
		failures: o.failures
	}, t, $.bodyAccelerationX, $.bodyAccelerationY, p, o.damage ? r.height * Math.abs(d) / 2 + (f.altitude - s.altitude) : void 0);
	m && (s.angularVelocity = 0), o.damage ? Wi(o, r, $.massProperties) : qe(o.vehicle.propellantMass, $.massProperties, r), o.vehicle.vehicleMomentOfInertia = $.massProperties.momentOfInertia, Qo(o, t, m, $), Ql(o, f, c, l), Zo(o, t, $);
	let h = $o(o, r, $);
	return es(o, t, m, $.omega0, $.alpha0, h), Ql(o, f, c, l), Jl(e, o, t, n, r, i, $);
}
//#endregion
//#region src/core/step.ts
var eu = {}, tu = Vo();
function nu(e, t, n = eu, r = E) {
	let i = au(e, t, n, r, ru);
	return r.id === "super-heavy" && !i.damage?.terminal.active && ll(i, t, r, iu), i;
}
function ru(e, t, n) {
	zl(e, t, n, iu);
}
function iu(e, t, n, r) {
	return au(e, t, eu, r, n);
}
function au(e, t, n, r, i) {
	if (e.damage) return $l(e, t, n, r, i);
	let a = eo(e);
	if (r.id === "super-heavy" && e.status.landed) return a.engines.running.fill(!1), a.engines.ignitionCountdown.fill(null), a.world.environmentTime += t, a.world.updatedFrameCount += 1, a;
	r.id === "super-heavy" && (n.pitchControl !== void 0 || n.throttle !== void 0) && ga(a.autopilot), Yo(a, t, r, tu);
	let o = Xo(a, t, tu.bodyAccelerationX, tu.bodyAccelerationY, r);
	return Zo(a, t, tu), ts(a, t, r, tu, o), Jl(e, a, t, n, r, i, tu);
}
//#endregion
//#region src/app/loop.ts
var ou = 1 / 120;
//#endregion
export { d as _, Xs as a, Oo as c, eo as d, Aa as f, pe as g, E as h, Ys as i, To as l, bi as m, nu as n, wo as o, M as p, cl as r, _o as s, ou as t, Eo as u };
